verses.he: אִ֛ישׁ הָיָ֥ה בְאֶֽרֶץ ע֖וּץ אִיּ֣וֹב שְׁמ֑וֹ וְהָיָ֣ה הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֗וּא תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר וִירֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֥ר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.en: THERE was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was whole-hearted and upright, and one that feared G-d, and shunned evil.

verses.he: וַיִּוָּ֥לְדוּ ל֛וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥ה בָנִ֖ים וְשָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֣י מִ֠קְנֵהוּ שִֽׁבְעַ֨ת אַלְפֵי צֹ֜אן וּשְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֣י גְמַלִּ֗ים וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֤וֹת צֶֽמֶד בָּקָר֙ וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֲתוֹנ֔וֹת וַעֲבֻדָּ֖ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיְהִי֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא גָּד֖וֹל מִכָּל בְּנֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.en: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she-asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

verses.he: וְהָלְכ֤וּ בָנָיו֙ וְעָשׂ֣וּ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אִ֣ישׁ יוֹמ֑וֹ וְשָׁלְח֗וּ וְקָרְאוּ֙ לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אחיתיהםאחיתיהםאַחְיֽוֹתֵיהֶ֔םלֶאֱכֹ֥ל וְלִשְׁתּ֖וֹת עִמָּהֶֽם׃
verses.en: And his sons used to go and hold a feast in the house of each one upon his day; and they would send and invite their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֡י כִּ֣י הִקִּיפֽוּ֩ יְמֵ֨י הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֜ה וַיִּשְׁלַ֧ח אִיּ֣וֹב וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֗ם וְהִשְׁכִּ֣ים בַּבֹּקֶר֮ וְהֶעֱלָ֣ה עֹלוֹת֮ מִסְפַּ֣ר כֻּלָּם֒ כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר אִיּ֔וֹב אוּלַי֙ חָטְא֣וּ בָנַ֔י וּבֵרֲכ֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּלְבָבָ֑ם כָּ֛כָה יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אִיּ֖וֹב כָּל הַיָּמִֽים׃ פ
verses.en: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt-offerings according to the number of them all; for Job said: 'It may be that my sons have sinned, and blasphemed G-d in their hearts.' Thus did Job continually.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּב֥וֹא גַֽם הַשָּׂטָ֖ן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.en: Now it fell upon a day, that the sons of G-d came to present themselves before HaShem, and Satan came also among them.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל הַשָּׂטָ֖ן מֵאַ֣יִן תָּבֹ֑א וַיַּ֨עַן הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מִשּׁ֣וּט בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵֽהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.en: And HaShem said unto Satan: 'Whence comest thou?' Then Satan answered HaShem, and said: 'From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.'

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל הַשָּׂטָ֔ן הֲשַׂ֥מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֖ עַל עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין כָּמֹ֨הוּ֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֥ר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.en: And HaShem said unto Satan: 'Hast thou considered My servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a whole-hearted and an upright man, one that feareth G-d, and shunneth evil?'

verses.he: וַיַּ֧עַן הַשָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַֽחִנָּ֔ם יָרֵ֥א אִיּ֖וֹב אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: Then Satan answered HaShem, and said: 'Doth Job fear G-d for nought?

verses.he: הֲלֹֽא אתאתאַ֠תָּהשַׂ֣כְתָּ בַעֲד֧וֹ וּבְעַד בֵּית֛וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֖וֹ מִסָּבִ֑יב מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָיו֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּמִקְנֵ֖הוּ פָּרַ֥ץ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Hast not Thou made a hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath, on every side? Thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his possessions are increased in the land.

verses.he: וְאוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֖ע בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר ל֑וֹ אִם לֹ֥א עַל פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְבָרֲכֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: But put forth Thy hand now, and touch all that he hath, surely he will blaspheme Thee to Thy face.'

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל הַשָּׂטָ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה כָל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ רַ֣ק אֵלָ֔יו אַל תִּשְׁלַ֖ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵעִ֖ם פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: And HaShem said unto Satan: 'Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thy hand.' So Satan went forth from the presence of HaShem.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וּבָנָ֨יו וּבְנֹתָ֤יו אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְשֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן בְּבֵ֖ית אֲחִיהֶ֥ם הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.en: And it fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house,

verses.he: וּמַלְאָ֛ךְ בָּ֥א אֶל אִיּ֖וֹב וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַבָּקָר֙ הָי֣וּ חֹֽרְשׁ֔וֹת וְהָאֲתֹנ֖וֹת רֹע֥וֹת עַל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: that there came a messenger unto Job, and said: 'The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them;

verses.he: וַתִּפֹּ֤ל שְׁבָא֙ וַתִּקָּחֵ֔ם וְאֶת הַנְּעָרִ֖ים הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי חָ֑רֶב וָֽאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: and the Sabeans made a raid, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.'

verses.he: ע֣וֹד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְזֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַר֒ אֵ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֗ים נָֽפְלָה֙ מִן הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַתִּבְעַ֥ר בַּצֹּ֛אן וּבַנְּעָרִ֖ים וַתֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said: 'A fire of G-d is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.'

verses.he: ע֣וֹד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְזֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַר֒ כַּשְׂדִּ֞ים שָׂ֣מוּ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֗ים וַֽיִּפְשְׁט֤וּ עַל הַגְּמַלִּים֙ וַיִּקָּח֔וּם וְאֶת הַנְּעָרִ֖ים הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי חָ֑רֶב וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said: 'The Chaldeans set themselves in three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have taken them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.'

verses.he: עַ֚ד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְזֶ֖ה בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֤יךָ אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְשֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן בְּבֵ֖ית אֲחִיהֶ֥ם הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said: 'Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house;

verses.he: וְהִנֵּה֩ ר֨וּחַ גְּדוֹלָ֜ה בָּ֣אָה מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיִּגַּע֙ בְּאַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הַבַּ֔יִת וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל הַנְּעָרִ֖ים וַיָּמ֑וּתוּ וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: And, behold, there came a great wind from across the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young people, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.'

verses.he: וַיָּ֤קָם אִיּוֹב֙ וַיִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת מְעִל֔וֹ וַיָּ֖גָז אֶת רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped;

verses.he: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ עָרֹ֨ם יצתייצתייָצָ֜אתִימִבֶּ֣טֶן אִמִּ֗י וְעָרֹם֙ אָשׁ֣וּב שָׁ֔מָה יְהוָ֣ה נָתַ֔ן וַיהוָ֖ה לָקָ֑ח יְהִ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה מְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.en: And he said; naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither; HaShem gave, and HaShem hath taken away; blessed be the name of HaShem.

verses.he: בְּכָל זֹ֖את לֹא חָטָ֣א אִיּ֑וֹב וְלֹא נָתַ֥ן תִּפְלָ֖ה לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ פ
verses.en: For all this Job sinned not, nor ascribed aught unseemly to G-d.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּב֤וֹא גַֽם הַשָּׂטָן֙ בְּתֹכָ֔ם לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Again it fell upon a day, that the sons of G-d came to present themselves before HaShem, and Satan came also among them to present himself before HaShem.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל הַשָּׂטָ֔ן אֵ֥י מִזֶּ֖ה תָּבֹ֑א וַיַּ֨עַן הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מִשֻּׁ֣ט בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.en: And HaShem said unto Satan: 'From whence comest thou?' And Satan answered HaShem, and said: 'From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.'

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל הַשָּׂטָ֗ן הֲשַׂ֣מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֮ אֶל עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּוֹב֒ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין כָּמֹ֜הוּ בָּאָ֗רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וְעֹדֶ֨נּוּ֙ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּת֔וֹ וַתְּסִיתֵ֥נִי ב֖וֹ לְבַלְּע֥וֹ חִנָּֽם׃
verses.en: And HaShem said unto Satan: 'Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a whole-hearted and an upright man, one that feareth G-d, and shunneth evil? and he still holdeth fast his integrity, although thou didst move Me against him, to destroy him without cause.'

verses.he: וַיַּ֧עַן הַשָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר ע֣וֹר בְּעַד ע֗וֹר וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָאִ֔ישׁ יִתֵּ֖ן בְּעַ֥ד נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: And Satan answered HaShem, and said: 'Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

verses.he: אוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֥ע אֶל עַצְמ֖וֹ וְאֶל בְּשָׂר֑וֹ אִם לֹ֥א אֶל פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְבָרֲכֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: But put forth Thy hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, surely he will blaspheme Thee to Thy face.'

verses.he: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל הַשָּׂטָ֖ן הִנּ֣וֹ בְיָדֶ֑ךָ אַ֖ךְ אֶת נַפְשׁ֥וֹ שְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.en: And HaShem said unto Satan: 'Behold, he is in thy hand; only spare his life.'

verses.he: וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵאֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת אִיּוֹב֙ בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֔ע מִכַּ֥ף רַגְל֖וֹ עדעדוְעַ֥דקָדְקֳדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: So Satan went forth from the presence of HaShem, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot even unto his crown.

verses.he: וַיִּֽקַּֽח ל֣וֹ חֶ֔רֶשׂ לְהִתְגָּרֵ֖ד בּ֑וֹ וְה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּתוֹךְ הָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself therewith; and he sat among the ashes.

verses.he: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ עֹדְךָ֖ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּתֶ֑ךָ בָּרֵ֥ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָמֻֽת׃
verses.en: Then said his wife unto him: 'Dost thou still hold fast thine integrity? blaspheme G-d, and die.'

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗יהָ כְּדַבֵּ֞ר אַחַ֤ת הַנְּבָלוֹת֙ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי גַּ֣ם אֶת הַטּ֗וֹב נְקַבֵּל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְאֶת הָרָ֖ע לֹ֣א נְקַבֵּ֑ל בְּכָל זֹ֛את לֹא חָטָ֥א אִיּ֖וֹב בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃ פ
verses.en: But he said unto her: 'Thou speakest as one of the impious women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of G-d, and shall we not receive evil?' For all this did not Job sin with his lips.

verses.he: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֞וּ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֣י אִיּ֗וֹב אֵ֣ת כָּל הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֮ הַבָּ֣אָה עָלָיו֒ וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִמְּקֹמ֔וֹ אֱלִיפַ֤ז הַתֵּימָנִי֙ וּבִלְדַּ֣ד הַשּׁוּחִ֔י וְצוֹפַ֖ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֑י וַיִּוָּעֲד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו לָב֥וֹא לָנֽוּד ל֖וֹ וּֽלְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place, Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to bemoan him and to comfort him.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ אֶת עֵינֵיהֶ֤ם מֵרָחוֹק֙ וְלֹ֣א הִכִּירֻ֔הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם וַיִּבְכּ֑וּ וַֽיִּקְרְעוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְעִל֔וֹ וַיִּזְרְק֥וּ עָפָ֛ר עַל רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃
verses.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and threw dust upon their heads toward heaven.

verses.he: וַיֵּשְׁב֤וּ אִתּוֹ֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעַ֣ת לֵיל֑וֹת וְאֵין דֹּבֵ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ דָּבָ֔ר כִּ֣י רָא֔וּ כִּֽי גָדַ֥ל הַכְּאֵ֖ב מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spoke a word unto him; for they saw that his grief was very great.

verses.he: אַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן פָּתַ֤ח אִיּוֹב֙ אֶת פִּ֔יהוּ וַיְקַלֵּ֖ל אֶת יוֹמֽוֹ׃ פ
verses.en: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: And Job spoke, and said:

verses.he: יֹ֣אבַד י֭וֹם אִוָּ֣לֶד בּ֑וֹ וְהַלַּ֥יְלָה אָ֝מַ֗ר הֹ֣רָה גָֽבֶר׃
verses.en: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night wherein it was said: 'A man-child is brought forth.'

verses.he: הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֗וּא יְֽהִ֫י חֹ֥שֶׁךְ אַֽל יִדְרְשֵׁ֣הוּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְאַל תּוֹפַ֖ע עָלָ֣יו נְהָרָֽה׃
verses.en: Let that day be darkness; let not G-d inquire after it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

verses.he: יִגְאָלֻ֡הוּ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ֭צַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכָּן עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנָ֑ה יְ֝בַעֲתֻ֗הוּ כִּֽמְרִ֥ירֵי יֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own; let a cloud dwell upon it; let all that maketh black the day terrify it.

verses.he: הַלַּ֥יְלָה הַהוּא֮ יִקָּחֵ֪ה֫וּ אֹ֥פֶל אַל יִ֭חַדְּ בִּימֵ֣י שָׁנָ֑ה בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר יְ֝רָחִ֗ים אַל יָבֹֽא׃
verses.en: As for that night, let thick darkness seize upon it; let it not rejoice among the days of the year; let it not come into the number of the months.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֤ה הַלַּ֣יְלָה הַ֭הוּא יְהִ֣י גַלְמ֑וּד אַל תָּבֹ֖א רְנָנָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Lo, let that night be desolate; let no joyful voice come therein.

verses.he: יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ אֹרְרֵי י֑וֹם הָ֝עֲתִידִ֗ים עֹרֵ֥ר לִוְיָתָֽן׃
verses.en: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

verses.he: יֶחְשְׁכוּ֮ כּוֹכְבֵ֪י נִ֫שְׁפּ֥וֹ יְקַו לְא֥וֹר וָאַ֑יִן וְאַל יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה בְּעַפְעַפֵּי שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it behold the eyelids of the morning;

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א סָ֭גַר דַּלְתֵ֣י בִטְנִ֑י וַיַּסְתֵּ֥ר עָ֝מָ֗ל מֵעֵינָֽי׃
verses.en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid trouble from mine eyes.

verses.he: לָ֤מָּה לֹּ֣א מֵרֶ֣חֶם אָמ֑וּת מִבֶּ֖טֶן יָצָ֣אתִי וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
verses.en: Why died I not from the womb? Why did I not perish at birth?

verses.he: מַ֭דּוּעַ קִדְּמ֣וּנִי בִרְכָּ֑יִם וּמַה שָּׁ֝דַ֗יִם כִּ֣י אִינָֽק׃
verses.en: Why did the knees receive me? And wherefore the breasts, that I should suck?

verses.he: כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה שָׁכַ֣בְתִּי וְאֶשְׁק֑וֹט יָ֝שַׁ֗נְתִּי אָ֤ז יָנ֬וּחַֽ לִֽי׃
verses.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet; I should have slept; then had I been at rest--

verses.he: עִם מְ֭לָכִים וְיֹ֣עֲצֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַבֹּנִ֖ים חֳרָב֣וֹת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: With kings and counsellors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

verses.he: א֣וֹ עִם שָׂ֭רִים זָהָ֣ב לָהֶ֑ם הַֽמְמַלְאִ֖ים בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.en: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

verses.he: א֤וֹ כְנֵ֣פֶל טָ֭מוּן לֹ֣א אֶהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝עֹלְלִ֗ים לֹא רָ֥אוּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants that never saw light.

verses.he: שָׁ֣ם רְ֭שָׁעִים חָ֣דְלוּ רֹ֑גֶז וְשָׁ֥ם יָ֝נ֗וּחוּ יְגִ֣יעֵי כֹֽחַ׃
verses.en: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary are at rest.

verses.he: יַ֭חַד אֲסִירִ֣ים שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ ק֣וֹל נֹגֵֽשׂ׃
verses.en: There the prisoners are at ease together; they hear not the voice of the taskmaster.

verses.he: קָטֹ֣ן וְ֭גָדוֹל שָׁ֣ם ה֑וּא וְ֝עֶ֗בֶד חָפְשִׁ֥י מֵאֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.en: The small and great are there alike; and the servant is free from his master.

verses.he: לָ֤מָּה יִתֵּ֣ן לְעָמֵ֣ל א֑וֹר וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.en: Wherewith is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul--

verses.he: הַֽמְחַכִּ֣ים לַמָּ֣וֶת וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וַֽ֝יַּחְפְּרֻ֗הוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִֽים׃
verses.en: Who long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

verses.he: הַשְּׂמֵחִ֥ים אֱלֵי גִ֑יל יָ֝שִׂ֗ישׂוּ כִּ֣י יִמְצְאוּ קָֽבֶר׃
verses.en: Who rejoice unto exultation, and are glad, when they can find the grave?--

verses.he: לְ֭גֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר דַּרְכּ֣וֹ נִסְתָּ֑רָה וַיָּ֖סֶךְ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בַּעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To a man whose way is hid, and whom G-d hath hedged in?

verses.he: כִּֽי לִפְנֵ֣י לַ֭חְמִי אַנְחָתִ֣י תָבֹ֑א וַֽיִּתְּכ֥וּ כַ֝מַּ֗יִם שַׁאֲגֹתָֽי׃
verses.en: For my sighing cometh instead of my food, and my roarings are poured out like water.

verses.he: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד פָּ֭חַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵ֑נִי וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָ֝גֹ֗רְתִּי יָ֣בֹא לִֽי׃
verses.en: For the thing which I did fear is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of hath overtaken me.

verses.he: לֹ֤א שָׁלַ֨וְתִּי וְלֹ֖א שָׁקַ֥טְתִּי וְֽלֹא נָ֗חְתִּי וַיָּ֥בֹא רֹֽגֶז׃ פ
verses.en: I was not at ease, neither was I quiet, neither had I rest; but trouble came.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:

verses.he: הֲנִסָּ֬ה דָבָ֣ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ תִּלְאֶ֑ה וַעְצֹ֥ר בְּ֝מִלִּ֗ין מִ֣י יוּכָֽל׃
verses.en: If one venture a word unto thee, wilt thou be weary? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

verses.he: הִ֭נֵּה יִסַּ֣רְתָּ רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדַ֖יִם רָפ֣וֹת תְּחַזֵּֽק׃
verses.en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

verses.he: כּ֭וֹשֵׁל יְקִימ֣וּן מִלֶּ֑יךָ וּבִרְכַּ֖יִם כֹּרְע֣וֹת תְּאַמֵּֽץ׃
verses.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

verses.he: כִּ֤י עַתָּ֨ה תָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֣יךָ וַתֵּ֑לֶא תִּגַּ֥ע עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ וַתִּבָּהֵֽל׃
verses.en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou art weary; it toucheth thee, and thou art affrighted.

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א יִ֭רְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶ֑ךָ תִּ֝קְוָתְךָ֗ וְתֹ֣ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Is not thy fear of G-d thy confidence, and thy hope the integrity of thy ways?

verses.he: זְכָר נָ֗א מִ֤י ה֣וּא נָקִ֣י אָבָ֑ד וְ֝אֵיפֹ֗ה יְשָׁרִ֥ים נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
verses.en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתִי חֹ֣רְשֵׁי אָ֑וֶן וְזֹרְעֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל יִקְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.en: According as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow mischief, reap the same.

verses.he: מִנִּשְׁמַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וּמֵר֖וּחַ אַפּ֣וֹ יִכְלֽוּ׃
verses.en: By the breath of G-d they perish, and by the blast of His anger are they consumed.

verses.he: שַׁאֲגַ֣ת אַ֭רְיֵה וְק֣וֹל שָׁ֑חַל וְשִׁנֵּ֖י כְפִירִ֣ים נִתָּֽעוּ׃
verses.en: The lion roareth, and the fierce lion howleth--yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.

verses.he: לַ֭יִשׁ אֹבֵ֣ד מִבְּלִי טָ֑רֶף וּבְנֵ֥י לָ֝בִ֗יא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
verses.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the whelps of the lioness are scattered abroad.

verses.he: וְ֭אֵלַי דָּבָ֣ר יְגֻנָּ֑ב וַתִּקַּ֥ח אָ֝זְנִ֗י שֵׁ֣מֶץ מֶֽנְהֽוּ׃
verses.en: Now a word was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a whisper thereof.

verses.he: בִּ֭שְׂעִפִּים מֵחֶזְיֹנ֣וֹת לָ֑יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֥ל תַּ֝רְדֵּמָ֗ה עַל אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

verses.he: פַּ֣חַד קְ֭רָאַנִי וּרְעָדָ֑ה וְרֹ֖ב עַצְמוֹתַ֣י הִפְחִֽיד׃
verses.en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, and all my bones were made to shake.

verses.he: וְ֭רוּחַ עַל פָּנַ֣י יַחֲלֹ֑ף תְּ֝סַמֵּ֗ר שַֽׂעֲרַ֥ת בְּשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.en: Then a spirit passed before my face, that made the hair of my flesh to stand up.

verses.he: יַעֲמֹ֤ד וְֽלֹא אַכִּ֬יר מַרְאֵ֗הוּ תְּ֭מוּנָה לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י דְּמָמָ֖ה וָק֣וֹל אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.en: It stood still, but I could not discern the appearance thereof; a form was before mine eyes; I heard a still voice:

verses.he: הַֽ֭אֱנוֹשׁ מֵאֱל֣וֹהַ יִצְדָּ֑ק אִ֥ם מֵ֝עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ יִטְהַר גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.en: 'Shall mortal man be just before G-d? Shall a man be pure before his Maker?

verses.he: הֵ֣ן בַּ֭עֲבָדָיו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וּ֝בְמַלְאָכָ֗יו יָשִׂ֥ים תָּהֳלָֽה׃
verses.en: Behold, He putteth no trust in His servants, and His angels He chargeth with folly;

verses.he: אַ֤ף שֹׁכְנֵ֬י בָֽתֵּי חֹ֗מֶר אֲשֶׁר בֶּעָפָ֥ר יְסוֹדָ֑ם יְ֝דַכְּא֗וּם לִפְנֵי עָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

verses.he: מִבֹּ֣קֶר לָעֶ֣רֶב יֻכַּ֑תּוּ מִבְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָנֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.en: Betwixt morning and evening they are shattered; they perish for ever without any regarding it.

verses.he: הֲלֹא נִסַּ֣ע יִתְרָ֣ם בָּ֑ם יָ֝מ֗וּתוּ וְלֹ֣א בְחָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.'

verses.he: קְֽרָא נָ֭א הֲיֵ֣שׁ עוֹנֶ֑ךָּ וְאֶל מִ֖י מִקְּדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּפְנֶֽה׃
verses.en: Call now; is there any that will answer thee? And to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?

verses.he: כִּֽי לֶֽ֭אֱוִיל יַהֲרָג כָּ֑עַשׂ וּ֝פֹתֶ֗ה תָּמִ֥ית קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.en: For anger killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

verses.he: אֲֽנִי רָ֭אִיתִי אֱוִ֣יל מַשְׁרִ֑ישׁ וָאֶקּ֖וֹב נָוֵ֣הוּ פִתְאֹֽם׃
verses.en: I have seen the foolish taking root; but suddenly I beheld his habitation cursed.

verses.he: יִרְחֲק֣וּ בָנָ֣יו מִיֶּ֑שַׁע וְיִֽדַּכְּא֥וּ בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.en: His children are far from safety, and are crushed in the gate, with none to deliver them.

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר קְצִיר֨וֹ רָ֘עֵ֤ב יֹאכֵ֗ל וְאֶֽל מִצִּנִּ֥ים יִקָּחֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁאַ֖ף צַמִּ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃
verses.en: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the snare gapeth for their substance.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹא יֵצֵ֣א מֵעָפָ֣ר אָ֑וֶן וּ֝מֵאֲדָמָ֗ה לֹא יִצְמַ֥ח עָמָֽל׃
verses.en: For affliction cometh not forth from the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

verses.he: כִּֽי אָ֭דָם לְעָמָ֣ל יוּלָּ֑ד וּבְנֵי רֶ֝֗שֶׁף יַגְבִּ֥יהוּ עֽוּף׃
verses.en: But man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

verses.he: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶל אֵ֑ל וְאֶל אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אָשִׂ֥ים דִּבְרָתִֽי׃
verses.en: But as for me, I would seek unto G-d, and unto G-d would I commit my cause;

verses.he: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת וְאֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת עַד אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.en: Who doeth great things and unsearchable, marvellous things without number;

verses.he: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן מָ֭טָר עַל פְּנֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְשֹׁ֥לֵֽחַ מַ֝יִם עַל פְּנֵ֥י חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields;

verses.he: לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁפָלִ֣ים לְמָר֑וֹם וְ֝קֹדְרִ֗ים שָׂ֣גְבוּ יֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.en: So that He setteth up on high those that are low, and those that mourn are exalted to safety.

verses.he: מֵ֭פֵר מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת עֲרוּמִ֑ים וְֽלֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה יְ֝דֵיהֶ֗ם תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.en: He frustrateth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands can perform nothing substantial.

verses.he: לֹכֵ֣ד חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעָרְמָ֑ם וַעֲצַ֖ת נִפְתָּלִ֣ים נִמְהָֽרָה׃
verses.en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; and the counsel of the wily is carried headlong.

verses.he: יוֹמָ֥ם יְפַגְּשׁוּ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְ֝כַלַּ֗יְלָה יְֽמַשְׁשׁ֥וּ בַֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.en: They meet with darkness in the day-time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣שַׁע מֵ֭חֶרֶב מִפִּיהֶ֑ם וּמִיַּ֖ד חָזָ֣ק אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: But He saveth from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

verses.he: וַתְּהִ֣י לַדַּ֣ל תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝עֹלָ֗תָה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.en: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֤ה אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֱ֭נוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶ֣נּֽוּ אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּמוּסַ֥ר שַׁ֝דַּ֗י אַל תִּמְאָֽס׃
verses.en: Behold, happy is the man whom G-d correcteth; therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty.

verses.he: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַכְאִ֣יב וְיֶחְבָּ֑שׁ יִ֝מְחַ֗ץ וידווידווְיָדָ֥יותִּרְפֶּֽינָה׃
verses.en: For He maketh sore, and bindeth up; He woundeth, and His hands make whole.

verses.he: בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ צָ֭רוֹת יַצִּילֶ֑ךָּ וּבְשֶׁ֓בַע לֹא יִגַּ֖ע בְּךָ֣ רָֽע׃
verses.en: He will deliver thee in six troubles; yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

verses.he: בְּ֭רָעָב פָּֽדְךָ֣ מִמָּ֑וֶת וּ֝בְמִלְחָמָ֗ה מִ֣ידֵי חָֽרֶב׃
verses.en: In famine He will redeem thee from death; and in war from the power of the sword.

verses.he: בְּשׁ֣וֹט לָ֭שׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵ֑א וְֽלֹא תִירָ֥א מִ֝שֹּׁ֗ד כִּ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.en: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue; neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

verses.he: לְשֹׁ֣ד וּלְכָפָ֣ן תִּשְׂחָ֑ק וּֽמֵחַיַּ֥ת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אַל תִּירָֽא׃
verses.en: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh; neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

verses.he: כִּ֤י עִם אַבְנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה בְרִיתֶ֑ךָ וְחַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה הָשְׁלְמָה לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field; and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

verses.he: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי שָׁל֣וֹם אָהֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽפָקַדְתָּ֥ נָ֝וְךָ וְלֹ֣א תֶחֱטָֽא׃
verses.en: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt miss nothing.

verses.he: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי רַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֶ֗יךָ כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

verses.he: תָּב֣וֹא בְכֶ֣לַח אֱלֵי קָ֑בֶר כַּעֲל֖וֹת גָּדִ֣ישׁ בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a ripe age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in its season.

verses.he: הִנֵּה זֹ֭את חֲקַרְנ֥וּהָ כֶּֽן הִ֑יא שְׁ֝מָעֶ֗נָּה וְאַתָּ֥ה דַֽע לָֽךְ׃ פ
verses.en: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: ל֗וּ שָׁק֣וֹל יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל כַּעְשִׂ֑י והיתיוהיתיוְ֝הַוָּתִ֗יבְּֽמֹאזְנַ֥יִם יִשְׂאוּ יָֽחַד׃
verses.en: Oh that my vexation were but weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances altogether!

verses.he: כִּֽי עַתָּ֗ה מֵח֣וֹל יַמִּ֣ים יִכְבָּ֑ד עַל כֵּ֝֗ן דְּבָרַ֥י לָֽעוּ׃
verses.en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas; therefore are my words broken.

verses.he: כִּ֤י חִצֵּ֪י שַׁדַּ֡י עִמָּדִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲ֭מָתָם שֹׁתָ֣ה רוּחִ֑י בִּעוּתֵ֖י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַֽעַרְכֽוּנִי׃
verses.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof my spirit drinketh up; the terrors of G-d do set themselves in array against me.

verses.he: הֲיִֽנְהַק פֶּ֥רֶא עֲלֵי דֶ֑שֶׁא אִ֥ם יִגְעֶה שּׁ֝֗וֹר עַל בְּלִילֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

verses.he: הֲיֵאָכֵ֣ל תָּ֭פֵל מִבְּלִי מֶ֑לַח אִם יֶשׁ טַ֝֗עַם בְּרִ֣יר חַלָּמֽוּת׃
verses.en: Can that which hath no savour be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the juice of mallows?

verses.he: מֵאֲנָ֣ה לִנְגּ֣וֹעַ נַפְשִׁ֑י הֵ֝֗מָּה כִּדְוֵ֥י לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.en: My soul refuseth to touch them; they are as the sickness of my flesh.

verses.he: מִֽי יִ֭תֵּן תָּב֣וֹא שֶֽׁאֱלָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י יִתֵּ֥ן אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
verses.en: Oh that I might have my request, and that G-d would grant me the thing that I long for!

verses.he: וְיֹאֵ֣ל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ וִֽידַכְּאֵ֑נִי יַתֵּ֥ר יָ֝ד֗וֹ וִֽיבַצְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Even that it would please G-d to crush me; that He would let loose His hand, and cut me off!

verses.he: וּ֥תְהִי ע֨וֹד נֶ֘חָ֤מָתִ֗י וַאֲסַלְּדָ֣ה בְ֭חִילָה לֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל כִּי לֹ֥א כִ֝חַ֗דְתִּי אִמְרֵ֥י קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would exult in pain, though He spare not; for I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

verses.he: מַה כֹּחִ֥י כִֽי אֲיַחֵ֑ל וּמַה קִּ֝צִּ֗י כִּֽי אַאֲרִ֥יךְ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: What is my strength, that I should wait? and what is mine end, that I should be patient?

verses.he: אִם כֹּ֣חַ אֲבָנִ֣ים כֹּחִ֑י אִֽם בְּשָׂרִ֥י נָחֽוּשׁ׃
verses.en: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

verses.he: הַאִ֬ם אֵ֣ין עֶזְרָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְ֝תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה נִדְּחָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Is it that I have no help in me, and that sound wisdom is driven quite from me?

verses.he: לַמָּ֣ס מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ חָ֑סֶד וְיִרְאַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲזֽוֹב׃
verses.en: To him that is ready to faint kindness is due from his friend, even to him that forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

verses.he: אַ֭חַי בָּגְד֣וּ כְמוֹ נָ֑חַל כַּאֲפִ֖יק נְחָלִ֣ים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that overflow,

verses.he: הַקֹּדְרִ֥ים מִנִּי קָ֑רַח עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם שָֽׁלֶג׃
verses.en: Which are black by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow hideth itself;

verses.he: בְּ֭עֵת יְזֹרְב֣וּ נִצְמָ֑תוּ בְּ֝חֻמּ֗וֹ נִדְעֲכ֥וּ מִמְּקוֹמָֽם׃
verses.en: What time they wax warm, they vanish, when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

verses.he: יִ֭לָּ֣פְתוּ אָרְח֣וֹת דַּרְכָּ֑ם יַעֲל֖וּ בַתֹּ֣הוּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.en: The paths of their way do wind, they go up into the waste, and are lost.

verses.he: הִ֭בִּיטוּ אָרְח֣וֹת תֵּמָ֑א הֲלִיכֹ֥ת שְׁ֝בָ֗א קִוּוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: The caravans of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them--

verses.he: בֹּ֥שׁוּ כִּֽי בָטָ֑ח בָּ֥אוּ עָ֝דֶ֗יהָ וַיֶּחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: They were ashamed because they had hoped; they came thither, and were confounded.

verses.he: כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה הֱיִ֣יתֶם לאלאל֑וֹתִּֽרְא֥וּ חֲ֝תַ֗ת וַתִּירָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: For now ye are become His; ye see a terror, and are afraid.

verses.he: הֲֽכִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי הָ֣בוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מִכֹּחֲכֶ֗ם שִׁחֲד֥וּ בַעֲדִֽי׃
verses.en: Did I say: 'Give unto me'? or: 'Offer a present for me of your substance'?

verses.he: וּמַלְּט֥וּנִי מִיַּד צָ֑ר וּמִיַּ֖ד עָרִיצִ֣ים תִּפְדּֽוּנִי׃
verses.en: or: 'Deliver me from the adversary's hand'? or: 'Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors'?

verses.he: ה֭וֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ וּמַה שָּׁ֝גִ֗יתִי הָבִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃
verses.en: Teach me, and I will hold my peace; and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

verses.he: מַה נִּמְרְצ֥וּ אִמְרֵי יֹ֑שֶׁר וּמַה יּוֹכִ֖יחַ הוֹכֵ֣חַ מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.en: How forcible are words of uprightness! But what doth your arguing argue?

verses.he: הַלְהוֹכַ֣ח מִלִּ֣ים תַּחְשֹׁ֑בוּ וּ֝לְר֗וּחַ אִמְרֵ֥י נֹאָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Do ye hold words to be an argument, but the speeches of one that is desperate to be wind?

verses.he: אַף עַל יָת֥וֹם תַּפִּ֑ילוּ וְ֝תִכְר֗וּ עַל רֵֽיעֲכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Yea, ye would cast lots upon the fatherless, and dig a pit for your friend.

verses.he: וְ֭עַתָּה הוֹאִ֣ילוּ פְנוּ בִ֑י וְעַל פְּ֝נֵיכֶ֗ם אִם אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
verses.en: Now therefore be pleased to look upon me; for surely I shall not lie to your face.

verses.he: שֻֽׁבוּ נָ֭א אַל תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה ושביושביוְשׁ֥וּבוּע֝וֹד צִדְקִי בָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Return, I pray you, let there be no injustice; yea, return again, my cause is righteous.

verses.he: הֲיֵשׁ בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֥י עַוְלָ֑ה אִם חִ֝כִּ֗י לֹא יָבִ֥ין הַוּֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern crafty devices?

verses.he: הֲלֹא צָבָ֣א לֶאֱנ֣וֹשׁ עלעלעֲלֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְכִימֵ֖י שָׂכִ֣יר יָמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Is there not a time of service to man upon earth? And are not his days like the days of a hireling?

verses.he: כְּעֶ֥בֶד יִשְׁאַף צֵ֑ל וּ֝כְשָׂכִ֗יר יְקַוֶּ֥ה פָעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: As a servant that eagerly longeth for the shadow, and as a hireling that looketh for his wages;

verses.he: כֵּ֤ן הָנְחַ֣לְתִּי לִ֭י יַרְחֵי שָׁ֑וְא וְלֵיל֥וֹת עָ֝מָ֗ל מִנּוּ לִֽי׃
verses.en: So am I made to possess--months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

verses.he: אִם שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מָתַ֣י אָ֭קוּם וּמִדַּד עָ֑רֶב וְשָׂבַ֖עְתִּי נְדֻדִ֣ים עֲדֵי נָֽשֶׁף׃
verses.en: When I lie down, I say: 'When shall I arise?' But the night is long, and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

verses.he: לָ֘בַ֤שׁ בְּשָׂרִ֣י רִ֭מָּה וגישוגישוְג֣וּשׁעָפָ֑ר עוֹרִ֥י רָ֝גַ֗ע וַיִּמָּאֵֽס׃
verses.en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin closeth up and breaketh out afresh.

verses.he: יָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי אָ֑רֶג וַ֝יִּכְל֗וּ בְּאֶ֣פֶס תִּקְוָֽה׃
verses.en: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.

verses.he: זְ֭כֹר כִּי ר֣וּחַ חַיָּ֑י לֹא תָשׁ֥וּב עֵ֝ינִ֗י לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: O remember that my life is a breath; mine eye shall no more see good.

verses.he: לֹֽא תְ֭שׁוּרֵנִי עֵ֣ין רֹ֑אִי עֵינֶ֖יךָ בִּ֣י וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃
verses.en: The eye of him that seeth me shall behold me no more; while Thine eyes are upon me, I am gone.

verses.he: כָּלָ֣ה עָ֭נָן וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ כֵּ֥ן יוֹרֵ֥ד שְׁ֝א֗וֹל לֹ֣א יַעֲלֶֽה׃
verses.en: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away, so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.

verses.he: לֹא יָשׁ֣וּב ע֣וֹד לְבֵית֑וֹ וְלֹא יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

verses.he: גַּם אֲנִי֮ לֹ֤א אֶחֱשָׂ֫ךְ פִּ֥י אֲֽ֭דַבְּרָה בְּצַ֣ר רוּחִ֑י אָ֝שִׂ֗יחָה בְּמַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.he: הֲֽיָם אָ֭נִי אִם תַּנִּ֑ין כִּֽי תָשִׂ֖ים עָלַ֣י מִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.en: Am I a sea, or a sea-monster, that Thou settest a watch over me?

verses.he: כִּֽי אָ֭מַרְתִּי תְּנַחֲמֵ֣נִי עַרְשִׂ֑י יִשָּׂ֥א בְ֝שִׂיחִ֗י מִשְׁכָּבִֽי׃
verses.en: When I say: 'My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint';

verses.he: וְחִתַּתַּ֥נִי בַחֲלֹמ֑וֹת וּֽמֵחֶזְיֹנ֥וֹת תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Then Thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions;

verses.he: וַתִּבְחַ֣ר מַחֲנָ֣ק נַפְשִׁ֑י מָ֝֗וֶת מֵֽעַצְמוֹתָֽי׃
verses.en: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than these my bones.

verses.he: מָ֭אַסְתִּי לֹא לְעֹלָ֣ם אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה חֲדַ֥ל מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי כִּי הֶ֥בֶל יָמָֽי׃
verses.en: I loathe it; I shall not live alway; let me alone; for my days are vanity.

verses.he: מָֽה אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כִּ֣י תְגַדְּלֶ֑נּוּ וְכִי תָשִׁ֖ית אֵלָ֣יו לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: What is man, that Thou shouldest magnify him, and that Thou shouldest set Thy heart upon him,

verses.he: וַתִּפְקְדֶ֥נּוּ לִבְקָרִ֑ים לִ֝רְגָעִ֗ים תִּבְחָנֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: And that Thou shouldest remember him every morning, and try him every moment?

verses.he: כַּ֭מָּה לֹא תִשְׁעֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי לֹֽא תַ֝רְפֵּ֗נִי עַד בִּלְעִ֥י רֻקִּֽי׃
verses.en: How long wilt Thou not look away from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

verses.he: חָטָ֡אתִי מָ֤ה אֶפְעַ֨ל לָךְ֮ נֹצֵ֪ר הָאָ֫דָ֥ם לָ֤מָה שַׂמְתַּ֣נִי לְמִפְגָּ֣ע לָ֑ךְ וָאֶהְיֶ֖ה עָלַ֣י לְמַשָּֽׂא׃
verses.en: If I have sinned, what do I unto Thee, O Thou watcher of men? Why hast Thou set me as a mark for Thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

verses.he: וּמֶ֤ה לֹא תִשָּׂ֣א פִשְׁעִי֮ וְתַעֲבִ֪יר אֶת עֲוֺ֫נִ֥י כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה לֶעָפָ֣ר אֶשְׁכָּ֑ב וְשִׁ֖חֲרְתַּ֣נִי וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃ פ
verses.en: And why dost Thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? For now shall I lie down in the dust; and Thou wilt seek me, but I shall not be.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י וַיֹאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:

verses.he: עַד אָ֥ן תְּמַלֶּל אֵ֑לֶּה וְר֥וּחַ כַּ֝בִּיר אִמְרֵי פִֽיךָ׃
verses.en: How long wilt thou speak these things, seeing that the words of thy mouth are as a mighty wind?

verses.he: הַ֭אֵל יְעַוֵּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְאִם שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יְעַוֵּֽת צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.en: Doth G-d pervert judgment? Or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

verses.he: אִם בָּנֶ֥יךָ חָֽטְאוּ ל֑וֹ וַֽ֝יְשַׁלְּחֵ֗ם בְּיַד פִּשְׁעָֽם׃
verses.en: If thy children sinned against Him, He delivered them into the hand of their transgression.

verses.he: אִם אַ֭תָּה תְּשַׁחֵ֣ר אֶל אֵ֑ל וְאֶל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י תִּתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.en: If thou wouldest seek earnestly unto G-d, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

verses.he: אִם זַ֥ךְ וְיָשָׁ֗ר אָ֥תָּה כִּי עַ֭תָּה יָעִ֣יר עָלֶ֑יךָ וְ֝שִׁלַּ֗ם נְוַ֣ת צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now He would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֣ה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ֣ מִצְעָ֑ר וְ֝אַחֲרִיתְךָ֗ יִשְׂגֶּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: And though thy beginning was small, yet thy end should greatly increase.

verses.he: כִּֽי שְׁאַל נָ֭א לְדֹ֣ר רִישׁ֑וֹן וְ֝כוֹנֵ֗ן לְחֵ֣קֶר אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former generation, and apply thyself to that which their fathers have searched out--

verses.he: כִּֽי תְמ֣וֹל אֲ֭נַחְנוּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע כִּ֤י צֵ֖ל יָמֵ֣ינוּ עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow--

verses.he: הֲלֹא הֵ֣ם י֭וֹרוּךָ יֹ֣אמְרוּ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝מִלִּבָּ֗ם יוֹצִ֥אוּ מִלִּֽים׃
verses.en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

verses.he: הֲיִֽגְאֶה גֹּ֭מֶא בְּלֹ֣א בִצָּ֑ה יִשְׂגֶּה אָ֥חוּ בְלִי מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Can the rush shoot up without mire? Can the reed-grass grow without water?

verses.he: עֹדֶ֣נּוּ בְ֭אִבּוֹ לֹ֣א יִקָּטֵ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָל חָצִ֣יר יִיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Whilst it is yet in its greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

verses.he: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל שֹׁ֣כְחֵי אֵ֑ל וְתִקְוַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.en: So are the paths of all that forget G-d; and the hope of the godless man shall perish;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר יָק֥וֹט כִּסְל֑וֹ וּבֵ֥ית עַ֝כָּבִ֗ישׁ מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Whose confidence is gossamer, and whose trust is a spider's web.

verses.he: יִשָּׁעֵ֣ן עַל בֵּ֭יתוֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֑ד יַחֲזִ֥יק בּ֝֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יָקֽוּם׃
verses.en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand; he shall hold fast thereby, but it shall not endure.

verses.he: רָטֹ֣ב ה֭וּא לִפְנֵי שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְעַ֥ל גַּ֝נָּת֗וֹ יֹֽנַקְתּ֥וֹ תֵצֵֽא׃
verses.en: He is green before the sun, and his shoots go forth over his garden.

verses.he: עַל גַּ֭ל שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ בֵּ֖ית אֲבָנִ֣ים יֶחֱזֶֽה׃
verses.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, he beholdeth the place of stones.

verses.he: אִם יְבַלְּעֶ֥נּוּ מִמְּקוֹמ֑וֹ וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.en: If he be destroyed from his place, then it shall deny him: 'I have not seen thee.'

verses.he: הֶן ה֭וּא מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝מֵעָפָ֗ר אַחֵ֥ר יִצְמָֽחוּ׃
verses.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others spring.

verses.he: הֶן אֵ֭ל לֹ֣א יִמְאַס תָּ֑ם וְלֹֽא יַ֝חֲזִ֗יק בְּיַד מְרֵעִֽים׃
verses.en: Behold, G-d will not cast away an innocent man, neither will He uphold the evil-doers;

verses.he: עַד יְמַלֵּ֣ה שְׂח֣וֹק פִּ֑יךָ וּשְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ תְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: Till He fill thy mouth with laughter, and thy lips with shouting.

verses.he: שֹׂנְאֶ֥יךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ בֹ֑שֶׁת וְאֹ֖הֶל רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃ פ
verses.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the tent of the wicked shall be no more.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: אָ֭מְנָם יָדַ֣עְתִּי כִי כֵ֑ן וּמַה יִּצְדַּ֖ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם אֵֽל׃
verses.en: Of a truth I know that it is so; and how can man be just with G-d?

verses.he: אִם יַ֭חְפֹּץ לָרִ֣יב עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא יַ֝עֲנֶ֗נּוּ אַחַ֥ת מִנִּי אָֽלֶף׃
verses.en: If one should desire to contend with Him, he could not answer Him one of a thousand.

verses.he: חֲכַ֣ם לֵ֭בָב וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֑חַ מִֽי הִקְשָׁ֥ה אֵ֝לָ֗יו וַיִּשְׁלָֽם׃
verses.en: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength; who hath hardened himself against Him, and prospered?

verses.he: הַמַּעְתִּ֣יק הָ֭רִים וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲפָכָ֣ם בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Who removeth the mountains, and they know it not, when He overturneth them in His anger.

verses.he: הַמַּרְגִּ֣יז אֶ֭רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ וְ֝עַמּוּדֶ֗יהָ יִתְפַלָּצֽוּן׃
verses.en: Who shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

verses.he: הָאֹמֵ֣ר לַ֭חֶרֶס וְלֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ח וּבְעַ֖ד כּוֹכָבִ֣ים יַחְתֹּֽם׃
verses.en: Who commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

verses.he: נֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַ֣יִם לְבַדּ֑וֹ וְ֝דוֹרֵ֗ךְ עַל בָּ֥מֳתֵי יָֽם׃
verses.en: Who alone stretcheth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

verses.he: עֹֽשֶׂה עָ֭שׁ כְּסִ֥יל וְכִימָ֗ה וְחַדְרֵ֥י תֵמָֽן׃
verses.en: Who maketh the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

verses.he: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת עַד אֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר וְנִפְלָא֗וֹת עַד אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.en: Who doeth great things past finding out; yea, marvellous things without number.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן יַעֲבֹ֣ר עָ֭לַי וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝יַחֲלֹ֗ף וְֽלֹא אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Lo, He goeth by me, and I see Him not. He passeth on also, but I perceive Him not.

verses.he: הֵ֣ן יַ֭חְתֹּף מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ מִֽי יֹאמַ֥ר אֵ֝לָ֗יו מַֽה תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.en: Behold, He snatcheth away, who can hinder Him? Who will say unto Him: 'What doest Thou?'

verses.he: אֱ֭לוֹהַּ לֹא יָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ תחתותחתותַּחְתָּ֥יושָׁ֝חֲח֗וּ עֹ֣זְרֵי רָֽהַב׃
verses.en: G-d will not withdraw His anger; the helpers of Rahab did stoop under Him.

verses.he: אַ֭ף כִּֽי אָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ אֶבְחֲרָ֖ה דְבָרַ֣י עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: How much less shall I answer Him, and choose out my arguments with Him?

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם צָ֭דַקְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה לִ֝מְשֹׁפְטִ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.en: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer; I would make supplication to Him that contendeth with me.

verses.he: אִם קָרָ֥אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי לֹֽא אַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּֽי יַאֲזִ֥ין קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.en: If I had called, and He had answered me; yet would I not believe that He would hearken unto my voice--

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂעָרָ֥ה יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְהִרְבָּ֖ה פְצָעַ֣י חִנָּֽם׃
verses.en: He that would break me with a tempest, and multiply my wounds without cause;

verses.he: לֹֽא יִ֭תְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁ֣ב רוּחִ֑י כִּ֥י יַ֝שְׂבִּעַ֗נִי מַמְּרֹרִֽים׃
verses.en: That would not suffer me to take my breath, but fill me with bitterness.

verses.he: אִם לְכֹ֣חַ אַמִּ֣יץ הִנֵּ֑ה וְאִם לְ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מִ֣י יוֹעִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: If it be a matter of strength, lo, He is mighty! and if of justice, who will appoint me a time?

verses.he: אִם אֶ֭צְדָּק פִּ֣י יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי תָּֽם אָ֝֗נִי וַֽיַּעְקְשֵֽׁנִי׃
verses.en: Though I be righteous, mine own mouth shall condemn me; though I be innocent, He shall prove me perverse.

verses.he: תָּֽם אָ֭נִי לֹֽא אֵדַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶמְאַ֥ס חַיָּֽי׃
verses.en: I am innocent--I regard not myself, I despise my life.

verses.he: אַחַ֗ת הִ֥יא עַל כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֑רְתִּי תָּ֥ם וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע ה֣וּא מְכַלֶּֽה׃
verses.en: It is all one--therefore I say: He destroyeth the innocent and the wicked.

verses.he: אִם שׁ֭וֹט יָמִ֣ית פִּתְאֹ֑ם לְמַסַּ֖ת נְקִיִּ֣ם יִלְעָֽג׃
verses.en: If the scourge slay suddenly, He will mock at the calamity of the guiltless.

verses.he: אֶ֤רֶץ נִתְּנָ֬ה בְֽיַד רָשָׁ֗ע פְּנֵֽי שֹׁפְטֶ֥יהָ יְכַסֶּ֑ה אִם לֹ֖א אֵפ֣וֹא מִי הֽוּא׃
verses.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if it be not He, who then is it?

verses.he: וְיָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי רָ֑ץ בָּֽ֝רְח֗וּ לֹא רָא֥וּ טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.en: Now my days are swifter than a runner; they flee away, they see no good.

verses.he: חָ֭לְפוּ עִם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת אֵבֶ֑ה כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר יָט֥וּשׂ עֲלֵי אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.en: They are passed away as the swift ships; as the vulture that swoopeth on the prey.

verses.he: אִם אָ֭מְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָ֣ה שִׂיחִ֑י אֶעֶזְבָ֖ה פָנַ֣י וְאַבְלִֽיגָה׃
verses.en: If I say: 'I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad countenance, and be of good cheer',

verses.he: יָגֹ֥רְתִּי כָל עַצְּבֹתָ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי לֹ֥א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
verses.en: I am afraid of all my pains, I know that Thou wilt not hold me guiltless.

verses.he: אָנֹכִ֥י אֶרְשָׁ֑ע לָמָּה זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל אִיגָֽע׃
verses.en: I shall be condemned; why then do I labour in vain?

verses.he: אִם הִתְרָחַ֥צְתִּי במובמובְמֵי שָׁ֑לֶג וַ֝הֲזִכּ֗וֹתִי בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפָּֽי׃
verses.en: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

verses.he: אָ֭ז בַּשַּׁ֣חַת תִּטְבְּלֵ֑נִי וְ֝תִֽעֲב֗וּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָֽי׃
verses.en: Yet wilt Thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

verses.he: כִּי לֹא אִ֣ישׁ כָּמֹ֣נִי אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ נָב֥וֹא יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: For He is not a man, as I am, that I should answer Him, that we should come together in judgment.

verses.he: לֹ֣א יֵשׁ בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ מוֹכִ֑יחַ יָשֵׁ֖ת יָד֣וֹ עַל שְׁנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: There is no arbiter betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

verses.he: יָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י שִׁבְט֑וֹ וְ֝אֵמָת֗וֹ אַֽל תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Let Him take His rod away from me, and let not His terror make me afraid;

verses.he: אַֽ֭דַבְּרָה וְלֹ֣א אִירָאֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא כֵ֥ן אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.en: Then would I speak, and not fear Him; for I am not so with myself.

verses.he: נָֽקְטָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֗י בְּחַ֫יָּ֥י אֶֽעֶזְבָ֣ה עָלַ֣י שִׂיחִ֑י אֲ֝דַבְּרָה֗ בְּמַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: My soul is weary of my life; I will give free course to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.he: אֹמַ֣ר אֶל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ אַל תַּרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי הֽ֝וֹדִיעֵ֗נִי עַ֣ל מַה תְּרִיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: I will say unto G-d: Do not condemn me; make me know wherefore Thou contendest with me.

verses.he: הֲט֤וֹב לְךָ֨ כִּֽי תַעֲשֹׁ֗ק כִּֽי תִ֭מְאַס יְגִ֣יעַ כַּפֶּ֑יךָ וְעַל עֲצַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים הוֹפָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.en: Is it good unto Thee that Thou shouldest oppress, that Thou shouldest despise the work of Thy hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

verses.he: הַעֵינֵ֣י בָשָׂ֣ר לָ֑ךְ אִם כִּרְא֖וֹת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: Hast Thou eyes of flesh? or seest Thou as man seeth?

verses.he: הֲכִימֵ֣י אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָמֶ֑יךָ אִם שְׁ֝נוֹתֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣ימֵי גָֽבֶר׃
verses.en: Are Thy days as the days of man, or Thy years as a man's days,

verses.he: כִּֽי תְבַקֵּ֥שׁ לַעֲוֺנִ֑י וּ֭לְחַטָּאתִ֥י תִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: That Thou inquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin,

verses.he: עַֽל דַּ֭עְתְּךָ כִּי לֹ֣א אֶרְשָׁ֑ע וְאֵ֖ין מִיָּדְךָ֣ מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.en: Although Thou knowest that I shall not be condemned; and there is none that can deliver out of Thy hand?

verses.he: יָדֶ֣יךָ עִ֭צְּבוּנִי וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֑וּנִי יַ֥חַד סָ֝בִ֗יב וַֽתְּבַלְּעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thy hands have framed me and fashioned me together round about; yet Thou dost destroy me!

verses.he: זְכָר נָ֭א כִּי כַחֹ֣מֶר עֲשִׂיתָ֑נִי וְֽאֶל עָפָ֥ר תְּשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Remember, I beseech Thee, that Thou hast fashioned me as clay; and wilt Thou bring me into dust again?

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א כֶ֭חָלָב תַּתִּיכֵ֑נִי וְ֝כַגְּבִנָּ֗ה תַּקְפִּיאֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Hast Thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

verses.he: ע֣וֹר וּ֭בָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁ֑נִי וּֽבַעֲצָמ֥וֹת וְ֝גִידִ֗ים תְּסֹכְכֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

verses.he: חַיִּ֣ים וָ֭חֶסֶד עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝פְקֻדָּתְךָ֗ שָֽׁמְרָ֥ה רוּחִֽי׃
verses.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and Thy providence hath preserved my spirit.

verses.he: וְ֭אֵלֶּה צָפַ֣נְתָּ בִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי זֹ֥את עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Yet these things Thou didst hide in Thy heart; I know that this is with Thee;

verses.he: אִם חָטָ֥אתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּ֑נִי וּ֝מֵעֲוֺנִ֗י לֹ֣א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
verses.en: If I sin, then Thou markest me, and Thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

verses.he: אִם רָשַׁ֡עְתִּי אַלְלַ֬י לִ֗י וְ֭צָדַקְתִּי לֹא אֶשָּׂ֣א רֹאשִׁ֑י שְׂבַ֥ע קָ֝ל֗וֹן וּרְאֵ֥ה עָנְיִֽי׃
verses.en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head--being filled with ignominy and looking upon mine affliction.

verses.he: וְ֭יִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁ֣חַל תְּצוּדֵ֑נִי וְ֝תָשֹׁ֗ב תִּתְפַּלָּא בִֽי׃
verses.en: And if it exalt itself, Thou huntest me as a lion; and again Thou showest Thyself marvellous upon me.

verses.he: תְּחַדֵּ֬שׁ עֵדֶ֨יךָ נֶגְדִּ֗י וְתֶ֣רֶב כַּֽ֭עַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִ֑י חֲלִיפ֖וֹת וְצָבָ֣א עִמִּֽי׃
verses.en: Thou renewest Thy witnesses against me, and increasest Thine indignation upon me; host succeeding host against me.

verses.he: וְלָ֣מָּה מֵ֭רֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָ֑נִי אֶ֝גְוַ֗ע וְעַ֣יִן לֹא תִרְאֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Wherefore then hast Thou brought me forth out of the womb? Would that I had perished, and no eye had seen me!

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא הָיִ֣יתִי אֶהְיֶ֑ה מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן לַקֶּ֥בֶר אוּבָֽל׃
verses.en: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

verses.he: הֲלֹא מְעַ֣ט יָמַ֣י יחדליחדלוַחֲדָ֑לישיתישיתוְשִׁ֥יתמִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְאַבְלִ֥יגָה מְּעָֽט׃
verses.en: Are not my days few? Cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

verses.he: בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֵ֭לֵךְ וְלֹ֣א אָשׁ֑וּב אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

verses.he: אֶ֤רֶץ עֵיפָ֨תָה כְּמ֥וֹ אֹ֗פֶל צַ֭לְמָוֶת וְלֹ֥א סְדָרִ֗ים וַתֹּ֥פַע כְּמוֹ אֹֽפֶל׃ פ
verses.en: A land of thick darkness, as darkness itself; a land of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַֽנַּעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said:

verses.he: הֲרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֵעָנֶ֑ה וְאִם אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפָתַ֣יִם יִצְדָּֽק׃
verses.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be accounted right?

verses.he: בַּ֭דֶּיךָ מְתִ֣ים יַחֲרִ֑ישׁו וַ֝תִּלְעַ֗ג וְאֵ֣ין מַכְלִֽם׃
verses.en: Thy boastings have made men hold their peace, and thou hast mocked, with none to make thee ashamed;

verses.he: וַ֭תֹּאמֶר זַ֣ךְ לִקְחִ֑י וּ֝בַ֗ר הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: And thou hast said: 'My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in Thine eyes.'

verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן אֱל֣וֹהַּ דַּבֵּ֑ר וְיִפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתָ֣יו עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: But oh that G-d would speak, and open His lips against thee;

verses.he: וְיַגֶּד לְךָ֨ תַּֽעֲלֻמ֣וֹת חָכְמָה֮ כִּֽי כִפְלַ֪יִם לְֽת֫וּשִׁיָּ֥ה וְדַ֡ע כִּֽי יַשֶּׁ֥ה לְךָ֥ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: And that He would tell thee the secrets of wisdom, that sound wisdom is manifold! Know therefore that G-d exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

verses.he: הַחֵ֣קֶר אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּמְצָ֑א אִ֤ם עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית שַׁדַּ֣י תִּמְצָֽא׃
verses.en: Canst thou find out the deep things of G-d? Canst thou attain unto the purpose of the Almighty?

verses.he: גָּבְהֵ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם מַה תִּפְעָ֑ל עֲמֻקָּ֥ה מִ֝שְּׁא֗וֹל מַה תֵּדָֽע׃
verses.en: It is high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than the nether-world; what canst thou know?

verses.he: אֲרֻכָּ֣ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִדָּ֑הּ וּ֝רְחָבָ֗ה מִנִּי יָֽם׃
verses.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

verses.he: אִם יַחֲלֹ֥ף וְיַסְגִּ֑יר וְ֝יַקְהִ֗יל וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: If He pass by, and shut up, or gather in, then who can hinder Him?

verses.he: כִּי ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע מְתֵי שָׁ֑וְא וַיַּרְא אָ֝֗וֶן וְלֹ֣א יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.en: For He knoweth base men; and when He seeth iniquity, will He not then consider it?

verses.he: וְאִ֣ישׁ נָ֭בוּב יִלָּבֵ֑ב וְעַ֥יִר פֶּ֝֗רֶא אָדָ֥ם יִוָּלֵֽד׃
verses.en: But an empty man will get understanding, when a wild ass's colt is born a man.

verses.he: אִם אַ֭תָּ֗ה הֲכִינ֣וֹתָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֖ אֵלָ֣יו כַּפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: If thou set thy heart aright, and stretch out thy hands toward Him--

verses.he: אִם אָ֣וֶן בְּ֭יָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵ֑הוּ וְאַל תַּשְׁכֵּ֖ן בְּאֹהָלֶ֣יךָ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.en: If iniquity be in thy hand, put it far away, and let not unrighteousness dwell in thy tents--

verses.he: כִּי אָ֤ז תִּשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֣יךָ מִמּ֑וּם וְהָיִ֥יתָ מֻ֝צָ֗ק וְלֹ֣א תִירָֽא׃
verses.en: Surely then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear;

verses.he: כִּי אַ֭תָּה עָמָ֣ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח כְּמַ֖יִם עָבְר֣וּ תִזְכֹּֽר׃
verses.en: For thou shalt forget thy misery; thou shalt remember it as waters that are passed away;

verses.he: וּֽ֭מִצָּהֳרַיִם יָק֣וּם חָ֑לֶד תָּ֝עֻ֗פָה כַּבֹּ֥קֶר תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.en: And thy life shall be clearer than the noonday; though there be darkness, it shall be as the morning.

verses.he: וּֽ֭בָטַחְתָּ כִּי יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝חָפַרְתָּ֗ לָבֶ֥טַח תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.en: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt look about thee, and shalt take thy rest in safety.

verses.he: וְֽ֭רָבַצְתָּ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְחִלּ֖וּ פָנֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.en: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

verses.he: וְעֵינֵ֥י רְשָׁעִ֗ים תִּ֫כְלֶ֥ינָה וּ֭מָנוֹס אָבַ֣ד מִנְהֶ֑ם וְ֝תִקְוָתָ֗ם מַֽפַּח נָֽפֶשׁ׃ פ
verses.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall have no way to flee, and their hope shall be the drooping of the soul.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: אָ֭מְנָם כִּ֣י אַתֶּם עָ֑ם וְ֝עִמָּכֶ֗ם תָּמ֥וּת חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

verses.he: גַּם לִ֤י לֵבָ֨ב כְּֽמוֹכֶ֗ם לֹא נֹפֵ֣ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּ֑ם וְאֶת מִי אֵ֥ין כְּמוֹ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you; yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

verses.he: שְׂחֹ֤ק לְרֵעֵ֨הוּ אֶֽהְיֶ֗ה קֹרֵ֣א לֶ֭אֱלוֹהַּ וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ שְׂ֝ח֗וֹק צַדִּ֥יק תָּמִֽים׃
verses.en: I am as one that is a laughing-stock to his neighbour, a man that called upon G-d, and He answered him; the just, the innocent man is a laughing-stock,

verses.he: לַפִּ֣יד בּ֭וּז לְעַשְׁתּ֣וּת שַׁאֲנָ֑ן נָ֝כ֗וֹן לְמ֣וֹעֲדֵי רָֽגֶל׃
verses.en: A contemptible brand in the thought of him that is at ease, a thing ready for them whose foot slippeth.

verses.he: יִשְׁלָ֤יוּ אֹֽהָלִ֨ים לְשֹׁ֥דְדִ֗ים וּֽ֭בַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּ֣יזֵי אֵ֑ל לַאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבִ֖יא אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The tents of robbers prosper, and they that provoke G-d are secure, in whatsoever G-d bringeth into their hand.

verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁאַל נָ֣א בְהֵמ֣וֹת וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וְע֥וֹף הַ֝שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְיַגֶּד לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee;

verses.he: א֤וֹ שִׂ֣יחַ לָאָ֣רֶץ וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ דְּגֵ֣י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.en: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee;

verses.he: מִ֭י לֹא יָדַ֣ע בְּכָל אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֥י יַד יְ֝הוָה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּֽאת׃
verses.en: Who knoweth not among all these, that the hand of HaShem hath wrought this?

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל חָ֑י וְ֝ר֗וּחַ כָּל בְּשַׂר אִֽישׁ׃
verses.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.--

verses.he: הֲלֹא אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ אֹ֣כֶל יִטְעַם לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Doth not the ear try words, even as the palate tasteth its food?

verses.he: בִּֽישִׁישִׁ֥ים חָכְמָ֑ה וְאֹ֖רֶךְ יָמִ֣ים תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.en: Is wisdom with aged men, and understanding in length of days?--

verses.he: עִ֭מּוֹ חָכְמָ֣ה וּגְבוּרָ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ עֵצָ֥ה וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.en: With Him is wisdom and might; He hath counsel and understanding.

verses.he: הֵ֣ן יַ֭הֲרוֹס וְלֹ֣א יִבָּנֶ֑ה יִסְגֹּ֥ר עַל אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֹ֣א יִפָּתֵֽחַ׃
verses.en: Behold, He breaketh down, and it cannot be built again; He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן יַעְצֹ֣ר בַּמַּ֣יִם וְיִבָ֑שׁוּ וִֽ֝ישַׁלְּחֵ֗ם וְיַ֖הַפְכוּ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Behold, He withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; also He sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

verses.he: עִ֭מּוֹ עֹ֣ז וְתֽוּשִׁיָּ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ שֹׁגֵ֥ג וּמַשְׁגֶּֽה׃
verses.en: With Him is strength and sound wisdom; the deceived and the deceiver are His.

verses.he: מוֹלִ֣יךְ יוֹעֲצִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְֽשֹׁפְטִ֥ים יְהוֹלֵֽל׃
verses.en: He leadeth counsellors away stripped, and judges maketh He fools.

verses.he: מוּסַ֣ר מְלָכִ֣ים פִּתֵּ֑חַ וַיֶּאְסֹ֥ר אֵ֝ז֗וֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: He looseth the bond of kings, and bindeth their loins with a girdle.

verses.he: מוֹלִ֣יךְ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְאֵֽתָנִ֣ים יְסַלֵּֽף׃
verses.en: He leadeth priests away stripped, and overthroweth the mighty.

verses.he: מֵסִ֣יר שָׂ֭פָה לְנֶאֱמָנִ֑ים וְטַ֖עַם זְקֵנִ֣ים יִקָּֽח׃
verses.en: He removeth the speech of men of trust, and taketh away the sense of the elders.

verses.he: שׁוֹפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל נְדִיבִ֑ים וּמְזִ֖יחַ אֲפִיקִ֣ים רִפָּֽה׃
verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and looseth the belt of the strong.

verses.he: מְגַלֶּ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקוֹת מִנִּי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵ֖א לָא֣וֹר צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: He uncovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

verses.he: מַשְׂגִּ֣יא לַ֭גּוֹיִם וַֽיְאַבְּדֵ֑ם שֹׁטֵ֥חַ לַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם וַיַּנְחֵֽם׃
verses.en: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them; He enlargeth the nations, and leadeth them away.

verses.he: מֵסִ֗יר לֵ֭ב רָאשֵׁ֣י עַם הָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.en: He taketh away the heart of the chiefs of the people of the land, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.he: יְמַֽשְׁשׁוּ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא א֑וֹר וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם כַּשִּׁכּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: They grope in the dark without light, and He maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.

verses.he: הֶן כֹּ֭ל רָאֲתָ֣ה עֵינִ֑י שָֽׁמְעָ֥ה אָ֝זְנִ֗י וַתָּ֥בֶן לָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.

verses.he: כְּֽ֭דַעְתְּכֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם אָ֑נִי לֹא נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.en: What ye know, do I know also; I am not inferior unto you.

verses.he: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְהוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ׃
verses.en: Notwithstanding I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with G-d.

verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹֽפְלֵי שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.en: But ye are plasterers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

verses.he: מִֽי יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it would be your wisdom.

verses.he: שִׁמְעוּ נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑י וְרִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃
verses.en: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

verses.he: הַ֭לְאֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝ל֗וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.en: Will ye speak unrighteously for G-d, and talk deceitfully for Him?

verses.he: הֲפָנָ֥יו תִּשָּׂא֑וּן אִם לָאֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּן׃
verses.en: Will ye show Him favour? Will ye contend for G-d?

verses.he: הֲ֭טוֹב כִּֽי יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם כְּהָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Would it be good that He should search you out? Or as one mocketh a man, will ye mock Him?

verses.he: הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם בַּ֝סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן׃
verses.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly show favour.

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֑ם וּ֝פַחְדּ֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Shall not His majesty terrify you, and His dread fall upon you?

verses.he: זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי אֵ֑פֶר לְגַבֵּי חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Your memorials shall be like unto ashes, your eminences to eminences of clay.

verses.he: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אָ֑נִי וְיַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣י מָֽה׃
verses.en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

verses.he: עַל מָ֤ה אֶשָּׂ֣א בְשָׂרִ֣י בְשִׁנָּ֑י וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָשִׂ֥ים בְּכַפִּֽי׃
verses.en: Wherefore? I will take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand.

verses.he: הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵנִי לאלאל֣וֹאֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ דְּ֝רָכַ֗י אֶל פָּנָ֥יו אוֹכִֽיחַ׃
verses.en: Though He slay me, yet will I trust in Him; but I will argue my ways before Him.

verses.he: גַּם הוּא לִ֥י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי לֹ֥א לְ֝פָנָ֗יו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.en: This also shall be my salvation, that a hypocrite cannot come before Him.

verses.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝אַֽחֲוָתִ֗י בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Hear diligently my speech, and let my declaration be in your ears.

verses.he: הִנֵּה נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק׃
verses.en: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

verses.he: מִי ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י כִּֽי עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
verses.en: Who is he that will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and die.

verses.he: אַךְ שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑י אָ֥ז מִ֝פָּנֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר׃
verses.en: Only do not two things unto me, then will I not hide myself from Thee:

verses.he: כַּ֭פְּךָ מֵעָלַ֣י הַרְחַ֑ק וְ֝אֵ֥מָתְךָ֗ אַֽל תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Withdraw Thy hand far from me; and let not Thy terror make me afraid.

verses.he: וּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַהֲשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Then call Thou, and I will answer; or let me speak, and answer Thou me.

verses.he: כַּמָּ֣ה לִ֭י עֲוֺנ֣וֹת וְחַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥י וְ֝חַטָּאתִ֗י הֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.

verses.he: לָֽמָּה פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְתַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: Wherefore hidest Thou Thy face, and holdest me for Thine enemy?

verses.he: הֶעָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְאֶת קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף׃
verses.en: Wilt Thou harass a driven leaf? And wilt Thou pursue the dry stubble?

verses.he: כִּֽי תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝תוֹרִישֵׁ֗נִי עֲוֺנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽי׃
verses.en: That Thou shouldest write bitter things against me, and make me to inherit the iniquities of my youth.

verses.he: וְתָ֘שֵׂ֤ם בַּסַּ֨ד רַגְלַ֗י וְתִשְׁמ֥וֹר כָּל אָרְחוֹתָ֑י עַל שָׁרְשֵׁ֥י רַ֝גְלַ֗י תִּתְחַקֶּֽה׃
verses.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; Thou drawest Thee a line about the soles of my feet;

verses.he: וְ֭הוּא כְּרָקָ֣ב יִבְלֶ֑ה כְּ֝בֶ֗גֶד אֲכָ֣לוֹ עָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Though I am like a wine-skin that consumeth, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

verses.he: אָ֭דָם יְל֣וּד אִשָּׁ֑ה קְצַ֥ר יָ֝מִ֗ים וּֽשְׂבַֽע רֹֽגֶז׃
verses.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

verses.he: כְּצִ֣יץ יָ֭צָא וַיִּמָּ֑ל וַיִּבְרַ֥ח כַּ֝צֵּ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֽוֹד׃
verses.en: He cometh forth like a flower, and withereth; he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

verses.he: אַף עַל זֶ֭ה פָּקַ֣חְתָּ עֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאֹ֘תִ֤י תָבִ֖יא בְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: And dost Thou open Thine eyes upon such a one, and bringest me into judgment with Thee?

verses.he: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן טָ֭הוֹר מִטָּמֵ֗א לֹ֣א אֶחָֽד׃
verses.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

verses.he: אִ֥ם חֲרוּצִ֨ים יָמָ֗יו מִֽסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁ֥יו אִתָּ֑ךְ חקוחקוחֻקָּ֥יועָ֝שִׂ֗יתָ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with Thee, and Thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

verses.he: שְׁעֵ֣ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וְיֶחְדָּ֑ל עַד יִ֝רְצֶ֗ה כְּשָׂכִ֥יר יוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Look away from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.

verses.he: כִּ֤י יֵ֥שׁ לָעֵ֗ץ תִּ֫קְוָ֥ה אִֽם יִ֭כָּרֵת וְע֣וֹד יַחֲלִ֑יף וְ֝יֹֽנַקְתּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תֶחְדָּֽל׃
verses.en: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

verses.he: אִם יַזְקִ֣ין בָּאָ֣רֶץ שָׁרְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בֶעָפָ֗ר יָמ֥וּת גִּזְעֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

verses.he: מֵרֵ֣יחַ מַ֣יִם יַפְרִ֑חַ וְעָשָׂ֖ה קָצִ֣יר כְּמוֹ נָֽטַע׃
verses.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and put forth boughs like a plant.

verses.he: וְגֶ֣בֶר יָ֭מוּת וַֽיֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ וַיִּגְוַ֖ע אָדָ֣ם וְאַיּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: But man dieth, and lieth low; yea, man perisheth, and where is he?

verses.he: אָֽזְלוּ מַ֭יִם מִנִּי יָ֑ם וְ֝נָהָ֗ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river is drained dry;

verses.he: וְאִ֥ישׁ שָׁכַ֗ב וְֽלֹא יָ֫ק֥וּם עַד בִּלְתִּ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ וְלֹֽא יֵ֝עֹ֗רוּ מִשְּׁנָתָֽם׃
verses.en: So man lieth down and riseth not; till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

verses.he: מִ֤י יִתֵּ֨ן בִּשְׁא֬וֹל תַּצְפִּנֵ֗נִי תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי עַד שׁ֣וּב אַפֶּ֑ךָ תָּ֤שִׁ֥ית לִ֖י חֹ֣ק וְתִזְכְּרֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Oh that Thou wouldest hide me in the nether-world, that Thou wouldest keep me secret, until Thy wrath be past, that Thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!--

verses.he: אִם יָמ֥וּת גֶּ֗בֶר הֲיִ֫חְיֶ֥ה כָּל יְמֵ֣י צְבָאִ֣י אֲיַחֵ֑ל עַד בּ֝֗וֹא חֲלִיפָתִֽי׃
verses.en: If a man die, may he live again? All the days of my service would I wait, till my relief should come--

verses.he: תִּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ךָּ לְֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ תִכְסֹֽף׃
verses.en: Thou wouldest call, and I would answer Thee; Thou wouldest have a desire to the work of Thy hands.

verses.he: כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה צְעָדַ֣י תִּסְפּ֑וֹר לֹֽא תִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹר עַל חַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.en: But now Thou numberest my steps, Thou dost not even wait for my sin;

verses.he: חָתֻ֣ם בִּצְר֣וֹר פִּשְׁעִ֑י וַ֝תִּטְפֹּ֗ל עַל עֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and Thou heapest up mine iniquity.

verses.he: וְ֭אוּלָם הַר נוֹפֵ֣ל יִבּ֑וֹל וְ֝צ֗וּר יֶעְתַּ֥ק מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: And surely the mountain falling crumbleth away, and the rock is removed out of its place;

verses.he: אֲבָנִ֤ים שָׁ֥חֲקוּ מַ֗יִם תִּשְׁטֹֽף סְפִיחֶ֥יהָ עֲפַר אָ֑רֶץ וְתִקְוַ֖ת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ׃
verses.en: The waters wear the stones; the overflowings thereof wash away the dust of the earth; so Thou destroyest the hope of man.

verses.he: תִּתְקְפֵ֣הוּ לָ֭נֶצַח וַֽיַּהֲלֹ֑ךְ מְשַׁנֶּ֥ה פָ֝נָ֗יו וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth; Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

verses.he: יִכְבְּד֣וּ בָ֭נָיו וְלֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וְ֝יִצְעֲר֗וּ וְֽלֹא יָבִ֥ין לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he regardeth them not.

verses.he: אַךְ בְּ֭שָׂרוֹ עָלָ֣יו יִכְאָ֑ב וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו תֶּאֱבָֽל׃ פ
verses.en: But his flesh grieveth for him, and his soul mourneth over him.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:

verses.he: הֶֽחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַֽעַת ר֑וּחַ וִֽימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Should a wise man make answer with windy knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

verses.he: הוֹכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽם׃
verses.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

verses.he: אַף אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי אֵֽל׃
verses.en: Yea, thou doest away with fear, and impairest devotion before G-d.

verses.he: כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲוֺנְךָ֣ פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים׃
verses.en: For thine iniquity teacheth thy mouth, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

verses.he: יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ֣ פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא אָ֑נִי וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ בָֽךְ׃
verses.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

verses.he: הֲרִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.en: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou brought forth before the hills?

verses.he: הַבְס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְתִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣יךָ חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: Dost thou hearken in the council of G-d? And dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

verses.he: מַה יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?

verses.he: גַּם שָׂ֣ב גַּם יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵאָבִ֣יךָ יָמִֽים׃
verses.en: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than thy father.

verses.he: הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ תַּנְחֻמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Are the consolations of G-d too small for thee, and the word that dealeth gently with thee?

verses.he: מַה יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּֽמַה יִּרְזְמ֥וּן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? And why do thine eyes wink?

verses.he: כִּֽי תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑ךָ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ מִלִּֽין׃
verses.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against G-d, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth.

verses.he: מָֽה אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְכִֽי יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.en: What is man, that he should be clean? And he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.he: הֵ֣ן בקדשובקדשובִּ֭קְדֹשָׁיולֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.en: Behold, He putteth no trust in His holy ones; yea, the heavens are not clean in His sight.

verses.he: אַ֭ף כִּֽי נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַמַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.en: How much less one that is abominable and impure, man who drinketh iniquity like water!

verses.he: אֲחַוְךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑י וְזֶֽה חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃
verses.en: I will tell thee, hear thou me; and that which I have seen I will declare--

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְלֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it;

verses.he: לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.en: Unto whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them.

verses.he: כָּל יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃
verses.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

verses.he: קוֹל פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאָזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: A sound of terrors is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

verses.he: לֹא יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וצפווצפווְצָפ֖וּיה֣וּא אֱלֵי חָֽרֶב׃
verses.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

verses.he: נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע כִּֽי נָכ֖וֹן בְּיָד֣וֹ יֽוֹם חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: He wandereth abroad for bread: 'Where is it?' He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

verses.he: יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Distress and anguish overwhelm him; they prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

verses.he: כִּֽי נָטָ֣ה אֶל אֵ֣ל יָד֑וֹ וְאֶל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃
verses.en: Because he hath stretched out his hand against G-d, and behaveth himself proudly against the Almighty;

verses.he: יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣יו בְּצַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽיו׃
verses.en: He runneth upon him with a stiff neck, with the thick bosses of his bucklers.

verses.he: כִּֽי כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּחֶלְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי כָֽסֶל׃
verses.en: Because he hath covered his face with his fatness, and made collops of fat on his loins;

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָד֗וֹת בָּ֭תִּים לֹא יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים׃
verses.en: And he hath dwelt in desolate cities, in houses which no man would inhabit, which were ready to become heaps.

verses.he: לֹֽא יֶ֭עְשַׁר וְלֹא יָק֣וּם חֵיל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽם׃
verses.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall their produce bend to the earth.

verses.he: לֹֽא יָס֨וּר מִנִּי חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹֽ֭נַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝יָס֗וּר בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו׃
verses.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of His mouth shall he go away.

verses.he: אַל יַאֲמֵ֣ן בשובשובַּשָּׁ֣יונִתְעָ֑ה כִּי שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself; for vanity shall be his recompense.

verses.he: בְּֽלֹא י֭וֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵ֑א וְ֝כִפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה׃
verses.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be leafy.

verses.he: יַחְמֹ֣ס כַּגֶּ֣פֶן בִּסְר֑וֹ וְיַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ כַּ֝זַּ֗יִת נִצָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

verses.he: כִּֽי עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אָֽהֳלֵי שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.en: For the company of the godless shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

verses.he: הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְיָ֣לֹד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝בִטְנָ֗ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה׃ ס
verses.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי כְאֵ֣לֶּה רַבּ֑וֹת מְנַחֲמֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.en: I have heard many such things; sorry comforters are ye all.

verses.he: הֲקֵ֥ץ לְדִבְרֵי ר֑וּחַ א֥וֹ מַה יַּ֝מְרִֽיצְךָ֗ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.en: Shall windy words have an end? Or what provoketh thee that thou answerest?

verses.he: גַּ֤ם אָנֹכִי֮ כָּכֶ֪ם אֲדַ֫בֵּ֥רָה ל֤וּ יֵ֪שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֡ם תַּ֤חַת נַפְשִׁ֗י אַחְבִּ֣ירָה עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בְּמִלִּ֑ים וְאָנִ֥יעָה עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם בְּמ֣וֹ רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: I also could speak as ye do; if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you.

verses.he: אֲאַמִּצְכֶ֥ם בְּמוֹ פִ֑י וְנִ֖יד שְׂפָתַ֣י יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.en: I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips would assuage your grief.

verses.he: אִֽם אֲ֭דַבְּרָה לֹא יֵחָשֵׂ֣ךְ כְּאֵבִ֑י וְ֝אַחְדְּלָ֗ה מַה מִנִּ֥י יַהֲלֹֽךְ׃
verses.en: Though I speak, my pain is not assuaged; and though I forbear, what am I eased?

verses.he: אַךְ עַתָּ֥ה הֶלְאָ֑נִי הֲ֝שִׁמּ֗וֹתָ כָּל עֲדָתִֽי׃
verses.en: But now He hath made me weary; Thou hast made desolate all my company.

verses.he: וַֽ֭תִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵ֣ד הָיָ֑ה וַיָּ֥קָם בִּ֥י כַ֝חֲשִׁ֗י בְּפָנַ֥י יַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.en: And Thou hast shrivelled me up, which is a witness against me; and my leanness riseth up against me, it testifieth to my face.

verses.he: אַפּ֤וֹ טָרַ֨ף וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֵ֗נִי חָרַ֣ק עָלַ֣י בְּשִׁנָּ֑יו צָרִ֓י יִלְט֖וֹשׁ עֵינָ֣יו לִֽי׃
verses.en: He hath torn me in His wrath, and hated me; He hath gnashed upon me with His teeth; mine adversary sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

verses.he: פָּעֲר֬וּ עָלַ֨י בְּפִיהֶ֗ם בְּ֭חֶרְפָּה הִכּ֣וּ לְחָיָ֑י יַ֝֗חַד עָלַ֥י יִתְמַלָּאֽוּן׃
verses.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek scornfully; they gather themselves together against me.

verses.he: יַסְגִּירֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל אֶ֣ל עֲוִ֑יל וְעַל יְדֵ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְטֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: G-d delivereth me to the ungodly, and casteth me into the hands of the wicked.

verses.he: שָׁ֘לֵ֤ו הָיִ֨יתִי וַֽיְפַרְפְּרֵ֗נִי וְאָחַ֣ז בְּ֭עָרְפִּי וַֽיְפַצְפְּצֵ֑נִי וַיְקִימֵ֥נִי ל֝֗וֹ לְמַטָּרָֽה׃
verses.en: I was at ease, and He broke me asunder; yea, He hath taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces; He hath also set me up for His mark.

verses.he: יָ֘סֹ֤בּוּ עָלַ֨י רַבָּ֗יו יְפַלַּ֣ח כִּ֭לְיוֹתַי וְלֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מְרֵרָֽתִי׃
verses.en: His archers compass me round about, He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.

verses.he: יִפְרְצֵ֣נִי פֶ֭רֶץ עַל פְּנֵי פָ֑רֶץ יָרֻ֖ץ עָלַ֣י כְּגִבּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach; He runneth upon me like a giant.

verses.he: שַׂ֣ק תָּ֭פַרְתִּי עֲלֵ֣י גִלְדִּ֑י וְעֹלַ֖לְתִּי בֶעָפָ֣ר קַרְנִֽי׃
verses.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and have laid my horn in the dust.

verses.he: פָּנַ֣י חמרמרהחמרמרהחֳ֭מַרְמְרוּמִנִּי בֶ֑כִי וְעַ֖ל עַפְעַפַּ֣י צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: My face is reddened with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

verses.he: עַ֭ל לֹא חָמָ֣ס בְּכַפָּ֑י וּֽתְפִלָּתִ֥י זַכָּֽה׃
verses.en: Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

verses.he: אֶ֭רֶץ אַל תְּכַסִּ֣י דָמִ֑י וְֽאַל יְהִ֥י מָ֝ק֗וֹם לְזַעֲקָתִֽי׃
verses.en: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no resting-place.

verses.he: גַּם עַ֭תָּה הִנֵּה בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם עֵדִ֑י וְ֝שָׂהֲדִ֗י בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
verses.en: Even now, behold, my Witness is in heaven, and He that testifieth of me is on high.

verses.he: מְלִיצַ֥י רֵעָ֑י אֶל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ דָּלְפָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃
verses.en: Mine inward thoughts are my intercessors, mine eye poureth out tears unto G-d;

verses.he: וְיוֹכַ֣ח לְגֶ֣בֶר עִם אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּֽבֶן אָדָ֥ם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: That He would set aright a man contending with G-d, as a son of man setteth aright his neighbour!

verses.he: כִּֽי שְׁנ֣וֹת מִסְפָּ֣ר יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ וְאֹ֖רַח לֹא אָשׁ֣וּב אֶהֱלֹֽךְ׃
verses.en: For the years that are few are coming on, and I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

verses.he: רוּחִ֣י חֻ֭בָּלָה יָמַ֥י נִזְעָ֗כוּ קְבָרִ֥ים לִֽי׃
verses.en: My spirit is consumed, my days are extinct, the grave is ready for me.

verses.he: אִם לֹ֣א הֲ֭תֻלִים עִמָּדִ֑י וּ֝בְהַמְּרוֹתָ֗ם תָּלַ֥ן עֵינִֽי׃
verses.en: Surely there are mockers with me, and mine eye abideth in their provocation.

verses.he: שִֽׂימָה נָּ֭א עָרְבֵ֣נִי עִמָּ֑ךְ מִֽי ה֝֗וּא לְיָדִ֥י יִתָּקֵֽעַ׃
verses.en: Give now a pledge, be surety for me with Thyself; who else is there that will strike hands with me?

verses.he: כִּֽי לִ֭בָּם צָפַ֣נְתָּ מִּשָּׂ֑כֶל עַל כֵּ֝֗ן לֹ֣א תְרֹמֵֽם׃
verses.en: For Thou hast hid their heart from understanding; therefore shalt Thou not exalt them.

verses.he: לְ֭חֵלֶק יַגִּ֣יד רֵעִ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו תִּכְלֶֽנָה׃
verses.en: He that denounceth his friends for the sake of flattery, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

verses.he: וְֽ֭הִצִּגַנִי לִמְשֹׁ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְתֹ֖פֶת לְפָנִ֣ים אֶֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and I am become one in whose face they spit.

verses.he: וַתֵּ֣כַהּ מִכַּ֣עַשׂ עֵינִ֑י וִֽיצֻרַ֖י כַּצֵּ֣ל כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.en: Mine eye also is dimmed by reason of vexation, and all my members are as a shadow.

verses.he: יָשֹׁ֣מּוּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים עַל זֹ֑את וְ֝נָקִ֗י עַל חָנֵ֥ף יִתְעֹרָֽר׃
verses.en: Upright men are astonished at this, and the innocent stirreth up himself against the godless.

verses.he: וְיֹאחֵ֣ז צַדִּ֣יק דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּֽטֳהָר יָ֝דַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף אֹֽמֶץ׃
verses.en: Yet the righteous holdeth on his way, and he that hath clean hands waxeth stronger and stronger.

verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם כֻּלָּ֣ם תָּ֭שֻׁבוּ וּבֹ֣אוּ נָ֑א וְלֹֽא אֶמְצָ֖א בָכֶ֣ם חָכָֽם׃
verses.en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now; and I shall not find a wise man among you.

verses.he: יָמַ֣י עָ֭בְרוּ זִמֹּתַ֣י נִתְּק֑וּ מ֖וֹרָשֵׁ֣י לְבָבִֽי׃
verses.en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

verses.he: לַ֭יְלָה לְי֣וֹם יָשִׂ֑ימוּ א֝֗וֹר קָר֥וֹב מִפְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: They change the night into day; the light is short because of darkness.

verses.he: אִם אֲ֭קַוֶּה שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתִ֑י בַּ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ רִפַּ֥דְתִּי יְצוּעָֽי׃
verses.en: If I look for the nether-world as my house; if I have spread my couch in the darkness;

verses.he: לַשַּׁ֣חַת קָ֭רָאתִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אִמִּ֥י וַ֝אֲחֹתִ֗י לָֽרִמָּֽה׃
verses.en: If I have said to corruption: 'Thou art my father', to the worm: 'Thou art my mother, and my sister';

verses.he: וְ֭אַיֵּה אֵפ֣וֹ תִקְוָתִ֑י וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י מִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Where then is my hope? And as for my hope, who shall see it?

verses.he: בַּדֵּ֣י שְׁאֹ֣ל תֵּרַ֑דְנָה אִם יַ֖חַד עַל עָפָ֣ר נָֽחַת׃ ס
verses.en: They shall go down to the bars of the nether-world, when we are at rest together in the dust.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:

verses.he: עַד אָ֤נָה תְּשִׂימ֣וּן קִנְצֵ֣י לְמִלִּ֑ין תָּ֝בִ֗ינוּ וְאַחַ֥ר נְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.en: How long will ye lay snares for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

verses.he: מַ֭דּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁ֣בְנוּ כַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נִ֝טְמִ֗ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed dull in your sight?

verses.he: טֹֽרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֗וֹ בְּאַ֫פּ֥וֹ הַ֭לְמַעַנְךָ תֵּעָ֣זַב אָ֑רֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק צ֝֗וּר מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, shall the earth be forsaken for thee? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?

verses.he: גַּ֤ם א֣וֹר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא יִ֝גַּ֗הּ שְׁבִ֣יב אִשּֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

verses.he: א֭וֹר חָשַׁ֣ךְ בְּאָהֳל֑וֹ וְ֝נֵר֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.en: The light shall be dark in his tent, and his lamp over him shall be put out.

verses.he: יֵֽ֭צְרוּ צַעֲדֵ֣י אוֹנ֑וֹ וְֽתַשְׁלִיכֵ֥הוּ עֲצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

verses.he: כִּֽי שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּרֶ֣שֶׁת בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וְעַל שְׂ֝בָכָ֗ה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon the toils.

verses.he: יֹאחֵ֣ז בְּעָקֵ֣ב פָּ֑ח יַחֲזֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו צַמִּֽים׃
verses.en: A gin shall take him by the heel, and a snare shall lay hold on him.

verses.he: טָמ֣וּן בָּאָ֣רֶץ חַבְל֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכֻּדְתּ֗וֹ עֲלֵ֣י נָתִֽיב׃
verses.en: A noose is hid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

verses.he: סָ֭בִיב בִּֽעֲתֻ֣הוּ בַלָּה֑וֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻ֥הוּ לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.en: Terrors shall overwhelm him on every side, and shall entrap him at his feet.

verses.he: יְהִי רָעֵ֥ב אֹנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֵ֗יד נָכ֥וֹן לְצַלְעֽוֹ׃
verses.en: His trouble shall be ravenous, and calamity shall be ready for his fall.

verses.he: יֹ֭אכַל בַּדֵּ֣י עוֹר֑וֹ יֹאכַ֥ל בַּ֝דָּ֗יו בְּכ֣וֹר מָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: It shall devour the members of his body, yea, the first-born of death shall devour his members.

verses.he: יִנָּתֵ֣ק מֵ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְ֝תַצְעִדֵ֗הוּ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃
