verses.en: That wherein he trusteth shall be plucked out of his tent; and he shall be brought to the king of terrors.

verses.he: תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן בְּ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְּלִי ל֑וֹ יְזֹרֶ֖ה עַל נָוֵ֣הוּ גָפְרִֽית׃
verses.en: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his; brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

verses.he: מִ֭תַּחַת שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יִבָ֑שׁוּ וּ֝מִמַּ֗עַל יִמַּ֥ל קְצִירֽוֹ׃
verses.en: His roots shall dry up beneath, and above shall his branch wither.

verses.he: זִֽכְרוֹ אָ֭בַד מִנִּי אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא שֵׁ֥ם ל֝֗וֹ עַל פְּנֵי חֽוּץ׃
verses.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name abroad.

verses.he: יֶ֭הְדְּפֻהוּ מֵא֣וֹר אֶל חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּֽמִתֵּבֵ֥ל יְנִדֻּֽהוּ׃
verses.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

verses.he: לֹ֘א נִ֤ין ל֣וֹ וְלֹא נֶ֣כֶד בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין שָׂ֝רִ֗יד בִּמְגוּרָֽיו׃
verses.en: He shall have neither son nor son's son among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

verses.he: עַל י֭וֹמוֹ נָשַׁ֣מּוּ אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים וְ֝קַדְמֹנִ֗ים אָ֣חֲזוּ שָֽׂעַר׃
verses.en: They that come after shall be astonished at his day, as they that went before are affrighted.

verses.he: אַךְ אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁכְּנ֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וְ֝זֶ֗ה מְק֣וֹם לֹא יָדַֽע אֵֽל׃ ס
verses.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not G-d.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: עַד אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּן נַפְשִׁ֑י וּֽתְדַכְּאוּנַ֥נִי בְמִלִּֽים׃
verses.en: How long will ye vex my soul, and crush me with words?

verses.he: זֶ֤ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים תַּכְלִימ֑וּנִי לֹֽא תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ לִֽי׃
verses.en: These ten times have ye reproached me; ye are not ashamed that ye deal harshly with me.

verses.he: וְאַף אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽי׃
verses.en: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

verses.he: אִם אָ֭מְנָם עָלַ֣י תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ וְתוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗י חֶרְפָּתִּֽי׃
verses.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach;

verses.he: דְּֽעוּ אֵ֭פוֹ כִּי אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑נִי וּ֝מְצוּד֗וֹ עָלַ֥י הִקִּֽיף׃
verses.en: Know now that G-d hath subverted my cause, and hath compassed me with His net.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְאֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: Behold, I cry out: 'Violence!' but I am not heard; I cry aloud, but there is no justice.

verses.he: אָרְחִ֣י גָ֭דַר וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְעַ֥ל נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים׃
verses.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and hath set darkness in my paths.

verses.he: כְּ֭בוֹדִי מֵעָלַ֣י הִפְשִׁ֑יט וַ֝יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

verses.he: יִתְּצֵ֣נִי סָ֭בִיב וָאֵלַ֑ךְ וַיַּסַּ֥ע כָּ֝עֵ֗ץ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃
verses.en: He hath broken me down on every side, and I am gone; and my hope hath He plucked up like a tree.

verses.he: וַיַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣י אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי ל֣וֹ כְצָרָֽיו׃
verses.en: He hath also kindled His wrath against me, and He counteth me unto Him as one of His adversaries.

verses.he: יַ֤חַד יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ גְדוּדָ֗יו וַיָּסֹ֣לּוּ עָלַ֣י דַּרְכָּ֑ם וַיַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְאָהֳלִֽי׃
verses.en: His troops come on together, and cast up their way against me, and encamp round about my tent.

verses.he: אַ֭חַי מֵעָלַ֣י הִרְחִ֑יק וְ֝יֹדְעַ֗י אַךְ זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.en: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are wholly estranged from me.

verses.he: חָדְל֥וּ קְרוֹבָ֑י וּֽמְיֻדָּעַ֥י שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃
verses.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

verses.he: גָּ֘רֵ֤י בֵיתִ֣י וְ֭אַמְהֹתַי לְזָ֣ר תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑נִי נָ֝כְרִ֗י הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger; I am become an alien in their sight.

verses.he: לְעַבְדִּ֣י קָ֭רָאתִי וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה בְּמוֹ פִ֝֗י אֶתְחַנֶּן לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: I call unto my servant, and he giveth me no answer, though I entreat him with my mouth.

verses.he: ר֭וּחִֽי זָ֣רָה לְאִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝חַנֹּתִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽי׃
verses.en: My breath is abhorred of my wife, and I am loathsome to the children of my tribe.

verses.he: גַּם עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ בִֽי׃
verses.en: Even urchins despised me; if I arise, they speak against me.

verses.he: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי כָּל מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑י וְזֶֽה אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ בִֽי׃
verses.en: All my intimate friends abhor me; and they whom I loved are turned against me.

verses.he: בְּעוֹרִ֣י וּ֭בִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑י וָ֝אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗ה בְּע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽי׃
verses.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

verses.he: חָנֻּ֬נִי חָנֻּ֣נִי אַתֶּ֣ם רֵעָ֑י כִּ֥י יַד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽי׃
verses.en: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of G-d hath touched me.

verses.he: לָ֭מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣נִי כְמוֹ אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.en: Why do ye persecute me as G-d, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

verses.he: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ וְיִכָּתְב֣וּן מִלָּ֑י מִֽי יִתֵּ֖ן בַּסֵּ֣פֶר וְיֻחָֽקוּ׃
verses.en: Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

verses.he: בְּעֵט בַּרְזֶ֥ל וְעֹפָ֑רֶת לָ֝עַ֗ד בַּצּ֥וּר יֵחָצְבֽוּן׃
verses.en: That with an iron pen and lead they were graven in the rock for ever!

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִי חָ֑י וְ֝אַחֲר֗וֹן עַל עָפָ֥ר יָקֽוּם׃
verses.en: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer liveth, and that He will witness at the last upon the dust;

verses.he: וְאַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִֽי נִקְּפוּ זֹ֑את וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י אֶֽחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ׃
verses.en: And when after my skin this is destroyed, then without my flesh shall I see G-d;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִ֨י אֶֽחֱזֶה לִּ֗י וְעֵינַ֣י רָא֣וּ וְלֹא זָ֑ר כָּל֖וּ כִלְיֹתַ֣י בְּחֵקִֽי׃
verses.en: Whom I, even I, shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another's. My reins are consumed within me.

verses.he: כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה נִּרְדָּף ל֑וֹ וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא בִֽי׃
verses.en: If ye say: 'How we will persecute him!' seeing that the root of the matter is found in me;

verses.he: גּ֤וּרוּ לָכֶ֨ם מִפְּנֵי חֶ֗רֶב כִּֽי חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּן שדיןשדיןשַׁדּֽוּן׃ ס
verses.en: Be ye afraid of the sword; for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said:

verses.he: לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי׃
verses.en: Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, even by reason of mine agitation that is in me.

verses.he: מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: I have heard the reproof which putteth me to shame, but out of my understanding my spirit answereth me.

verses.he: הֲזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Knowest thou not this of old time, since man was placed upon earth,

verses.he: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי רָֽגַע׃
verses.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the godless but for a moment?

verses.he: אִם יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑וֹ וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ לָעָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

verses.he: כְּֽ֭גֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung; they that have seen him shall say: 'Where is he?'

verses.he: כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.en: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found; yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

verses.he: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְלֹא ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The eye which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

verses.he: בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: His children shall appease the poor, and his hands shall restore his wealth.

verses.he: עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו מָלְא֣וּ עלומועלומועֲלוּמָ֑יווְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.en: His bones are full of his youth, but it shall lie down with him in the dust.

verses.he: אִם תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

verses.he: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;

verses.he: לַ֭חְמוֹ בְּמֵעָ֣יו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Yet his food in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

verses.he: חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ אֵֽל׃
verses.en: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again; G-d shall cast them out of his belly.

verses.he: רֹאשׁ פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה׃
verses.en: He shall suck the poison of asps; the viper's tongue shall slay him.

verses.he: אַל יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה׃
verses.en: He shall not look upon the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and curd.

verses.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס׃
verses.en: That which he laboured for shall he give back, and shall not swallow it down; according to the substance that he hath gotten, he shall not rejoice.

verses.he: כִּֽי רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: For he hath oppressed and forsaken the poor; he hath violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹא יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃
verses.en: Because he knew no quietness within him, in his greed he suffered nought to escape,

verses.he: אֵין שָׂרִ֥יד לְאָכְל֑וֹ עַל כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽוֹ׃
verses.en: There was nothing left that he devoured not--therefore his prosperity shall not endure.

verses.he: בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits; the hand of every one that is in misery shall come upon him.

verses.he: יְהִ֤י לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח בּ֭וֹ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: It shall be for the filling of his belly; He shall cast the fierceness of His wrath upon him, and shall cause it to rain upon him into his flesh.

verses.he: יִ֭בְרַח מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.en: If he flee from the iron weapon, the bow of brass shall strike him through.

verses.he: שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֪א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו אֵמִֽים׃
verses.en: He draweth it forth, and it cometh out of his body; yea, the glittering point cometh out of his gall; terrors are upon him.

verses.he: כָּל חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו תְּ֭אָכְלֵהוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: All darkness is laid up for his treasures; a fire not blown by man shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tent.

verses.he: יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity, and the earth shall rise up against him.

verses.he: יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The increase of his house shall depart, his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

verses.he: זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣וֹ מֵאֵֽל׃ פ
verses.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from G-d, and the heritage appointed unto him by G-d.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וּתְהִי זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Hear diligently my speech; and let this be your consolations.

verses.he: שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣י תַלְעִֽיג׃
verses.en: Suffer me, that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

verses.he: הֶ֭אָנֹכִי לְאָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑י וְאִם מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹא תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽי׃
verses.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? Or why should I not be impatient?

verses.he: פְּנוּ אֵלַ֥י וְהָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְשִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל פֶּֽה׃
verses.en: Turn unto me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

verses.he: וְאִם זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְאָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י פַּלָּצֽוּת׃
verses.en: Even when I remember I am affrighted, and horror hath taketh hold on my flesh.

verses.he: מַדּ֣וּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
verses.en: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, wax mighty in power?

verses.he: זַרְעָ֤ם נָכ֣וֹן לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑ם וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֗ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

verses.he: בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִפָּ֑חַד וְלֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Their houses are safe, without fear, neither is the rod of G-d upon them.

verses.he: שׁוֹר֣וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְלֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל׃
verses.en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

verses.he: יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭צֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝יַלְדֵיהֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן׃
verses.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

verses.he: יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּתֹ֣ף וְכִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב׃
verses.en: They sing to the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

verses.he: יבלויבלויְכַלּ֣וּבַטּ֣וֹב יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בְרֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ׃
verses.en: They spend their days in prosperity, and peacefully they go down to the grave.

verses.he: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְדַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ׃
verses.en: Yet they said unto G-d: 'Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of Thy ways.

verses.he: מַה שַׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי נַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ וּמַה נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve Him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto Him?'--

verses.he: הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְיָדָ֣ם טוּבָ֑ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand; the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.he: כַּמָּ֤ה נֵר רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְיָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣ימוֹ אֵידָ֑ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? that their calamity cometh upon them? that He distributeth pains in His anger?

verses.he: יִהְי֗וּ כְּתֶ֥בֶן לִפְנֵי ר֑וּחַ וּ֝כְמֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
verses.en: That they are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm stealeth away?

verses.he: אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן לְבָנָ֥יו אוֹנ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣יו וְיֵדָֽע׃
verses.en: 'G-d layeth up his iniquity for his children!' --let Him recompense it unto himself, that he may know it.

verses.he: יִרְא֣וּ עינועינועֵינָ֣יוכִּיד֑וֹ וּמֵחֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.en: Let his own eyes see his destruction, and let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

verses.he: כִּ֤י מַה חֶפְצ֣וֹ בְּבֵית֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וּמִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣יו חֻצָּֽצוּ׃
verses.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him? seeing the number of his months is determined.

verses.he: הַלְאֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד דָּ֑עַת וְ֝ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
verses.en: Shall any teach G-d knowledge? seeing it is He that judgeth those that are high.

verses.he: זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּעֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְשָׁלֵֽיו׃
verses.en: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet;

verses.he: עֲ֭טִינָיו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּמֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣יו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה׃
verses.en: His pails are full of milk, and the marrow of his bones is moistened.

verses.he: וְזֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְלֹֽא אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּטּוֹבָֽה׃
verses.en: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, and hath never tasted of good.

verses.he: יַ֭חַד עַל עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: They lie down alike in the dust, and the worm covereth them.

verses.he: הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וּ֝מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ׃
verses.en: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

verses.he: כִּ֤י תֹֽאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית נָדִ֑יב וְ֝אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.en: For ye say: 'Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?'

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝אֹתֹתָ֗ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way; and will ye misdeem their tokens,

verses.he: כִּ֤י לְי֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְי֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ׃
verses.en: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led forth to the day of wrath?

verses.he: מִֽי יַגִּ֣יד עַל פָּנָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֽוּא עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: But who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?

verses.he: וְ֭הוּא לִקְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽעַל גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד׃
verses.en: For he is borne to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb.

verses.he: מָֽתְקוּ ל֗וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י נָ֥חַל וְ֭אַחֲרָיו כָּל אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.en: The clods of the valley are sweet unto him, and all men draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

verses.he: וְ֭אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּנִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝תְשֽׁוּבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר מָֽעַל׃ ס
verses.en: How then comfort ye me in vain? And as for your answers, there remaineth only faithlessness?

verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּמָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:

verses.he: הַלְאֵ֥ל יִסְכָּן גָּ֑בֶר כִּֽי יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣ימוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.en: Can a man be profitable unto G-d? Or can he that is wise be profitable unto Him?

verses.he: הַחֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְאִם בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי תַתֵּ֥ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Is it any advantage to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain to Him, that thou makest thy ways blameless?

verses.he: הֲֽ֭מִיִּרְאָ֣תְךָ יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ יָב֥וֹא עִ֝מְּךָ֗ בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: Is it for thy fear of Him that He reproveth thee, that He entereth with thee into judgment?

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א רָעָֽתְךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה וְאֵֽין קֵ֝֗ץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Is not thy wickedness great? And are not thine iniquities without end?

verses.he: כִּֽי תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣יךָ חִנָּ֑ם וּבִגְדֵ֖י עֲרוּמִּ֣ים תַּפְשִֽׁיט׃
verses.en: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.he: לֹא מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

verses.he: וְאִ֣ישׁ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣וֹ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּנְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.en: And as a mighty man, who hath the earth, and as a man of rank, who dwelleth in it,

verses.he: אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּזְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא׃
verses.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.he: עַל כֵּ֭ן סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣יךָ פַחִ֑ים וִֽ֝יבַהֶלְךָ פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹֽם׃
verses.en: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden dread affrighted thee,

verses.he: אוֹ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽשִׁפְעַת מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see, and abundance of waters cover thee.

verses.he: הֲֽלֹא אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּרְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי רָֽמּוּ׃
verses.en: Is not G-d in the height of heaven? And behold the topmost of the stars, how high they are!

verses.he: וְֽ֭אָמַרְתָּ מַה יָּ֣דַֽע אֵ֑ל הַבְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
verses.en: And thou sayest: 'What doth G-d know? Can He judge through the dark cloud?

verses.he: עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר ל֭וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וְח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Thick clouds are a covering to Him, that He seeth not; and He walketh in the circuit of heaven.'

verses.he: הַאֹ֣רַח עוֹלָ֣ם תִּשְׁמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר דָּרְכ֣וּ מְתֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Wilt thou keep the old way which wicked men have trodden?

verses.he: אֲשֶֽׁר קֻמְּט֥וּ וְלֹא עֵ֑ת נָ֝הָ֗ר יוּצַ֥ק יְסוֹדָֽם׃
verses.en: Who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream;

verses.he: הָאֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַה יִּפְעַ֖ל שַׁדַּ֣י לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Who said unto G-d: 'Depart from us'; and what could the Almighty do unto them?

verses.he: וְה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּיהֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב וַעֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Yet He filled their houses with good things--but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.he: יִרְא֣וּ צַדִּיקִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: The righteous saw it, and were glad, and the innocent laugh them to scorn:

verses.he: אִם לֹ֣א נִכְחַ֣ד קִימָ֑נוּ וְ֝יִתְרָ֗ם אָ֣כְלָה אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: 'Surely their substance is cut off, and their abundance the fire hath consumed.'

verses.he: הַסְכֶּן נָ֣א עִמּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלם בָּ֝הֶ֗ם תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ֥ טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.en: Acquaint now thyself with Him, and be at peace; thereby shall thine increase be good.

verses.he: קַח נָ֣א מִפִּ֣יו תּוֹרָ֑ה וְשִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗יו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Receive, I pray thee, instruction from His mouth, and lay up His words in thy heart.

verses.he: אִם תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up--if thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents,

verses.he: וְשִׁית עַל עָפָ֥ר בָּ֑צֶר וּבְצ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.en: And lay thy treasure in the dust, and the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks;

verses.he: וְהָיָ֣ה שַׁדַּ֣י בְּצָרֶ֑יךָ וְכֶ֖סֶף תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: And the Almighty be thy treasure, and precious silver unto thee;

verses.he: כִּי אָ֭ז עַל שַׁדַּ֣י תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג וְתִשָּׂ֖א אֶל אֱל֣וֹהַּ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Then surely shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto G-d.

verses.he: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ וּנְדָרֶ֥יךָ תְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto Him, and He will hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows;

verses.he: וְֽתִגְזַר א֭וֹמֶר וְיָ֣קָם לָ֑ךְ וְעַל דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ נָ֣גַֽהּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and light shall shine upon thy ways.

verses.he: כִּֽי הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה וְשַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃
verses.en: When they cast thee down, thou shalt say: 'There is lifting up'; for the humble person He saveth.

verses.he: יְֽמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי נָקִ֑י וְ֝נִמְלַ֗ט בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃ פ
verses.en: He delivereth him that is innocent, yea, thou shalt be delivered through the cleanness of thy hands.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: גַּם הַ֭יּוֹם מְרִ֣י שִׂחִ֑י יָ֝דִ֗י כָּבְדָ֥ה עַל אַנְחָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Even to-day is my complaint bitter; my hand is become heavy because of my groaning.

verses.he: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵ֑הוּ אָ֝ב֗וֹא עַד תְּכוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Oh that I knew where I might find Him, that I might come even to His seat!

verses.he: אֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְפָנָ֣יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝פִ֗י אֲמַלֵּ֥א תוֹכָחֽוֹת׃
verses.en: I would order my cause before Him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

verses.he: אֵ֭דְעָה מִלִּ֣ים יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָבִ֗ינָה מַה יֹּ֥אמַר לִֽי׃
verses.en: I would know the words which He would answer me, and understand what He would say unto me.

verses.he: הַבְּרָב כֹּ֭חַ יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י לֹ֥א אַךְ ה֝֗וּא יָשִׂ֥ם בִּֽי׃
verses.en: Would He contend with me in His great power? Nay; but He would give heed unto me.

verses.he: שָׁ֗ם יָ֭שָׁר נוֹכָ֣ח עִמּ֑וֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָ֥ה לָ֝נֶ֗צַח מִשֹּׁפְטִֽי׃
verses.en: There the upright might reason with Him; so should I be delivered for ever from my Judge.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן קֶ֣דֶם אֶהֱלֹ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְ֝אָח֗וֹר וְֽלֹא אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Behold, I go forward, but He is not there, and backward, but I cannot perceive Him;

verses.he: שְׂמֹ֣אול בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ וְלֹא אָ֑חַז יַעְטֹ֥ף יָ֝מִ֗ין וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: On the left hand, when He doth work, but I cannot behold Him, He turneth Himself to the right hand, but I cannot see Him.

verses.he: כִּֽי יָ֭דַע דֶּ֣רֶךְ עִמָּדִ֑י בְּ֝חָנַ֗נִי כַּזָּהָ֥ב אֵצֵֽא׃
verses.en: For He knoweth the way that I take; when He hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

verses.he: בַּ֭אֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָ֣ה רַגְלִ֑י דַּרְכּ֖וֹ שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי וְלֹא אָֽט׃
verses.en: My foot hath held fast to His steps, His way have I kept, and turned not aside.

verses.he: מִצְוַ֣ת שְׂ֭פָתָיו וְלֹ֣א אָמִ֑ישׁ מֵ֝חֻקִּ֗י צָפַ֥נְתִּי אִמְרֵי פִֽיו׃
verses.en: I have not gone back from the commandment of His lips; I have treasured up the words of His mouth more than my necessary food.

verses.he: וְה֣וּא בְ֭אֶחָד וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ אִוְּתָ֣ה וַיָּֽעַשׂ׃
verses.en: But He is at one with Himself, and who can turn Him? And what His soul desireth, even that He doeth.

verses.he: כִּ֭י יַשְׁלִ֣ים חֻקִּ֑י וְכָהֵ֖נָּה רַבּ֣וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For He will perform that which is appointed for me; and many such things are with Him.

verses.he: עַל כֵּ֭ן מִפָּנָ֣יו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְאֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Therefore am I affrighted at His presence; when I consider, I am afraid of Him.

verses.he: וְ֭אֵל הֵרַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הִבְהִילָֽנִי׃
verses.en: Yea, G-d hath made my heart faint, and the Almighty hath affrighted me;

verses.he: כִּֽי לֹ֣א נִ֭צְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י כִּסָּה אֹֽפֶל׃
verses.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did He cover the thick darkness from my face.

verses.he: מַדּ֗וּעַ מִ֭שַּׁדַּי לֹא נִצְפְּנ֣וּ עִתִּ֑ים וידעווידעווְ֝יֹדְעָ֗יולֹא חָ֥זוּ יָמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Why are times not laid up by the Almighty? And why do not they that know Him see His days?

verses.he: גְּבֻל֥וֹת יַשִּׂ֑יגוּ עֵ֥דֶר גָּ֝זְל֗וּ וַיִּרְעֽוּ׃
verses.en: There are that remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed them.

verses.he: חֲמ֣וֹר יְתוֹמִ֣ים יִנְהָ֑גוּ יַ֝חְבְּל֗וּ שׁ֣וֹר אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.

verses.he: יַטּ֣וּ אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים מִדָּ֑רֶךְ יַ֥חַד חֻ֝בְּא֗וּ עֲנִיֵּי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: They turn the needy out of the way; the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן פְּרָאִ֨ים בַּֽמִּדְבָּ֗ר יָצְא֣וּ בְּ֭פָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵ֣י לַטָּ֑רֶף עֲרָבָ֥ה ל֥וֹ לֶ֝֗חֶם לַנְּעָרִֽים׃
verses.en: Behold, as wild asses in the wilderness they go forth to their work, seeking diligently for food; the desert yieldeth them bread for their children.

verses.he: בַּ֭שָּׂדֶה בְּלִיל֣וֹ יקצירויקצירויִקְצ֑וֹרוּוְכֶ֖רֶם רָשָׁ֣ע יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.en: They cut his provender in the field; and they despoil the vineyard of the wicked.

verses.he: עָר֣וֹם יָ֭לִינוּ מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת בַּקָּרָֽה׃
verses.en: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

verses.he: מִזֶּ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים יִרְטָ֑בוּ וּֽמִבְּלִ֥י מַ֝חְסֶ֗ה חִבְּקוּ צֽוּר׃
verses.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

verses.he: יִ֭גְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁ֣ד יָת֑וֹם וְֽעַל עָנִ֥י יַחְבֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: There are that pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor;

verses.he: עָר֣וֹם הִ֭לְּכוּ בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וּ֝רְעֵבִ֗ים נָ֣שְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר׃
verses.en: So that they go about naked without clothing, and being hungry they carry the sheaves;

verses.he: בֵּין שׁוּרֹתָ֥ם יַצְהִ֑ירוּ יְקָבִ֥ים דָּ֝רְכ֗וּ וַיִּצְמָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: They make oil within the rows of these men; they tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

verses.he: מֵ֘עִ֤יר מְתִ֨ים יִנְאָ֗קוּ וְנֶֽפֶשׁ חֲלָלִ֥ים תְּשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וֶ֝אֱל֗וֹהַּ לֹא יָשִׂ֥ים תִּפְלָֽה׃
verses.en: From out of the populous city men groan, and the soul of the wounded crieth out; yet G-d imputeth it not for unseemliness.

verses.he: הֵ֤מָּה הָיוּ֮ בְּֽמֹרְדֵ֫י א֥וֹר לֹֽא הִכִּ֥ירוּ דְרָכָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָ֝שְׁב֗וּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: These are of them that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

verses.he: לָא֡וֹר יָ֘ק֤וּם רוֹצֵ֗חַ יִֽקְטָל עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝בַלַּ֗יְלָה יְהִ֣י כַגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.en: The murderer riseth with the light, to kill the poor and needy; and in the night he is as a thief.

verses.he: וְעֵ֤ין נֹאֵ֨ף שָׁ֤מְרָֽה נֶ֣שֶׁף לֵ֭אמֹר לֹא תְשׁוּרֵ֣נִי עָ֑יִן וְסֵ֖תֶר פָּנִ֣ים יָשִֽׂים׃
verses.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying: 'No eye shall see me'; and he putteth a covering on his face.

verses.he: חָתַ֥ר בַּחֹ֗שֶׁךְ בָּ֫תִּ֥ים יוֹמָ֥ם חִתְּמוּ לָ֗מוֹ לֹא יָ֥דְעוּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.en: In the dark they dig through houses; they shut themselves up in the day-time; they know not the light.

verses.he: כִּ֤י יַחְדָּ֨ו בֹּ֣קֶר לָ֣מוֹ צַלְמָ֑וֶת כִּֽי יַ֝כִּ֗יר בַּלְה֥וֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: For the shadow of death is to all of them as the morning; for they know the terrors of the shadow of death.

verses.he: קַֽל ה֤וּא עַל פְּנֵי מַ֗יִם תְּקֻלַּ֣ל חֶלְקָתָ֣ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא יִ֝פְנֶה דֶּ֣רֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים׃
verses.en: He is swift upon the face of the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth; he turneth not by the way of the vineyards.

verses.he: צִיָּ֤ה גַם חֹ֗ם יִגְזְל֥וּ מֵֽימֵי שֶׁ֗לֶג שְׁא֣וֹל חָטָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters; so doth the nether-world those that have sinned.

verses.he: יִשְׁכָּ֘חֵ֤הוּ רֶ֨חֶם מְתָ֘ק֤וֹ רִמָּ֗ה ע֥וֹד לֹֽא יִזָּכֵ֑ר וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֖ר כָּעֵ֣ץ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.en: The womb forgetteth him; the worm feedeth sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and unrighteousness is broken as a tree.

verses.he: רֹעֶ֣ה עֲ֭קָרָה לֹ֣א תֵלֵ֑ד וְ֝אַלְמָנָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְיֵטִֽיב׃
verses.en: He devoureth the barren that beareth not; and doeth not good to the widow.

verses.he: וּמָשַׁ֣ךְ אַבִּירִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ יָ֝ק֗וּם וְֽלֹא יַאֲמִ֥ין בַּֽחַיִּֽין׃
verses.en: He draweth away the mighty also by his power; he riseth up, and he trusteth not his own life.

verses.he: יִתֶּן ל֣וֹ לָ֭בֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝עֵינֵ֗יהוּ עַל דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth, yet His eyes are upon their ways.

verses.he: ר֤וֹמּוּ מְּעַ֨ט וְֽאֵינֶ֗נּוּ וְֽהֻמְּכ֗וּ כַּכֹּ֥ל יִקָּפְצ֑וּן וּכְרֹ֖אשׁ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת יִמָּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: They are exalted for a little while, and they are gone; yea, they are brought low, they are gathered in as all others, and wither as the tops of the ears of corn.

verses.he: וְאִם לֹ֣א אֵ֭פוֹ מִ֣י יַכְזִיבֵ֑נִי וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְ֝אַ֗ל מִלָּתִֽי׃ ס
verses.en: And if it be not so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:

verses.he: הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Dominion and fear are with Him; He maketh peace in His high places.

verses.he: הֲיֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִגְדוּדָ֑יו וְעַל מִ֝֗י לֹא יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Is there any number of His armies? And upon whom doth not His light arise?

verses.he: וּמַה יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם אֵ֑ל וּמַה יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.en: How then can man be just with G-d? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

verses.he: הֵ֣ן עַד יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.en: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, and the stars are not pure in His sight;

verses.he: אַ֭ף כִּֽי אֱנ֣וֹשׁ רִמָּ֑ה וּבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃ פ
verses.en: How much less man, that is a worm! and the son of man, that is a maggot!

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: מֶה עָזַ֥רְתָּ לְלֹא כֹ֑חַ ה֝וֹשַׁ֗עְתָּ זְר֣וֹעַ לֹא עֹֽז׃
verses.en: How hast thou helped him that is without power! How hast thou saved the arm that hath no strength!

verses.he: מַה יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

verses.he: אֶת מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: With whose help hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came forth from thee?

verses.he: הָרְפָאִ֥ים יְחוֹלָ֑לוּ מִתַּ֥חַת מַ֝֗יִם וְשֹׁכְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: The shades tremble beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.he: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן׃
verses.en: The nether-world is naked before Him, and Destruction hath no covering.

verses.he: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל בְּלִי מָֽה׃
verses.en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty space, and hangeth the earth over nothing.

verses.he: צֹרֵֽר מַ֥יִם בְּעָבָ֑יו וְלֹא נִבְקַ֖ע עָנָ֣ן תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.en: He bindeth up the waters in His thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

verses.he: מְאַחֵ֥ז פְּנֵי כִסֵּ֑ה פַּרְשֵׁ֖ז עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He closeth in the face of His throne, and spreadeth His cloud upon it.

verses.he: חֹֽק חָ֭ג עַל פְּנֵי מָ֑יִם עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית א֣וֹר עִם חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: He hath described a boundary upon the face of the waters, unto the confines of light and darkness.

verses.he: עַמּוּדֵ֣י שָׁמַ֣יִם יְרוֹפָ֑פוּ וְ֝יִתְמְה֗וּ מִגַּעֲרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at His rebuke.

verses.he: בְּ֭כֹחוֹ רָגַ֣ע הַיָּ֑ם ובתובנתוובתובנתווּ֝בִתְבוּנָת֗וֹמָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב׃
verses.en: He stirreth up the sea with His power, and by His understanding He smiteth through Rahab.

verses.he: בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ׃
verses.en: By His breath the heavens are serene; His hand hath pierced the slant serpent.

verses.he: הֶן אֵ֤לֶּה קְצ֬וֹת דרכודרכודְּרָכָ֗יווּמַה שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גבורתוגבורתוגְּ֝בוּרוֹתָ֗יומִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃ ס
verses.en: Lo, these are but the outskirts of His ways; and how small a whisper is heard of Him! But the thunder of His mighty deeds who can understand?

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: And Job again took up his parable, and said:

verses.he: חַי אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: As G-d liveth, who hath taken away my right; and the Almighty, who hath dealt bitterly with me;

verses.he: כִּֽי כָל ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי׃
verses.en: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of G-d is in my nostrils,

verses.he: אִם תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנִ֗י אִם יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.en: Surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, neither shall my tongue utter deceit;

verses.he: חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם עַד אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹא אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Far be it from me that I should justify you; till I die I will not put away mine integrity from me.

verses.he: בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ לֹֽא יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗י מִיָּמָֽי׃
verses.en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go; my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

verses.he: יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל׃
verses.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and let him that riseth up against me be as the unrighteous.

verses.he: כִּ֤י מַה תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: For what is the hope of the godless, though he get him gain, when G-d taketh away his soul?

verses.he: הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵ֑ל כִּֽי תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה׃
verses.en: Will G-d hear his cry, when trouble cometh upon him?

verses.he: אִם עַל שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכָל עֵֽת׃
verses.en: Will he have his delight in the Almighty, and call upon G-d at all times?

verses.he: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד׃
verses.en: I will teach you concerning the hand of G-d; that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

verses.he: הֵן אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye become altogether vain?

verses.he: זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע עִם אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with G-d, and the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

verses.he: אִם יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמוֹ חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; and his offspring shall not have bread enough.

verses.he: שרידושרידושְׂ֭רִידָיובַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried by pestilence, and his widows shall make no lamentation.

verses.he: אִם יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

verses.he: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק׃
verses.en: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

verses.he: בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑וֹ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר׃
verses.en: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth which the keeper maketh.

verses.he: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: He lieth down rich, but there shall be not to gather; he openeth his eyes, and his wealth is not.

verses.he: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
verses.en: Terrors overtake him like waters; a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

verses.he: יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth; and it sweepeth him out of his place.

verses.he: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח׃
verses.en: Yea, it hurleth at him, and spareth not; he would fain flee from its power.

verses.he: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

verses.he: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃
verses.en: For there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

verses.he: בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.en: Iron is taken out of the dust, and brass is molten out of the stone.

verses.he: קֵ֤ץ שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: Man setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out to the furthest bound the stones of thick darkness and of the shadow of death.

verses.he: פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל מֵֽעִם גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ׃
verses.en: He breaketh open a shaft away from where men sojourn; they are forgotten of the foot that passeth by; they hang afar from men, they swing to and fro.

verses.he: אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread, and underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

verses.he: מְקוֹם סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The stones thereof are the place of sapphires, and it hath dust of gold.

verses.he: נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא יְדָ֣עוֹ עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה׃
verses.en: That path no bird of prey knoweth, neither hath the falcon's eye seen it;

verses.he: לֹֽא הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ בְנֵי שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל׃
verses.en: The proud beasts have not trodden it, nor hath the lion passed thereby.

verses.he: בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים׃
verses.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.

verses.he: בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכָל יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He cutteth out channels among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

verses.he: מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר׃ פ
verses.en: He bindeth the streams that they trickle not; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

verses.he: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃
verses.en: But wisdom, where shall it be found? And where is the place of understanding?

verses.he: לֹא יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
verses.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

verses.he: תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.en: The deep saith: 'It is not in me'; and the sea saith: 'It is not with me.'

verses.he: לֹא יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ׃
verses.en: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

verses.he: לֹֽא תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר׃
verses.en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

verses.he: לֹא יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי פָֽז׃
verses.en: Gold and glass cannot equal it; neither shall the exchange thereof be vessels of fine gold.

verses.he: רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃
verses.en: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal; yea, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

verses.he: לֹֽא יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה׃ פ
verses.en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

verses.he: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה׃
verses.en: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?

verses.he: וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל חָ֑י וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה׃
verses.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

verses.he: אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Destruction and Death say: 'We have heard a rumor thereof with our ears.'

verses.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת מְקוֹמָֽהּ׃
verses.en: G-d understandeth the way thereof, and He knoweth the place thereof.

verses.he: כִּי ה֭וּא לִקְצוֹת הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: For He looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

verses.he: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה׃
verses.en: When He maketh a weight for the wind, and meteth out the waters by measure.

verses.he: בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.en: When He made a decree for the rain, and a way for the storm of thunders;

verses.he: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם חֲקָרָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Then did He see it, and declare it; He established it, yea, and searched it out.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה׃ ס
verses.en: And unto man He said: 'Behold, the fear of the L-rd, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.'

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: And Job again took up his parable, and said:

verses.he: מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֥נִי כְיַרְחֵי קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when G-d watched over me;

verses.he: בְּהִלּ֣וֹ נֵ֭רוֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י לְ֝אוֹרוֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: When His lamp shined above my head, and by His light I walked through darkness;

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּימֵ֣י חָרְפִּ֑י בְּס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אָהֳלִֽי׃
verses.en: As I was in the days of my youth, when the converse of G-d was upon my tent;

verses.he: בְּע֣וֹד שַׁ֭דַּי עִמָּדִ֑י סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣י נְעָרָֽי׃
verses.en: When the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were about me;

verses.he: בִּרְחֹ֣ץ הֲלִיכַ֣י בְּחֵמָ֑ה וְצ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗י פַּלְגֵי שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.en: When my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil!

verses.he: בְּצֵ֣אתִי שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי קָ֑רֶת בָּ֝רְח֗וֹב אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽי׃
verses.en: When I went forth to the gate unto the city, when I prepared my seat in the broad place,

verses.he: רָא֣וּנִי נְעָרִ֣ים וְנֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִֽ֝ישִׁישִׁים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ׃
verses.en: The young men saw me and hid themselves, and the aged rose up and stood;

verses.he: שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְמִלִּ֑ים וְ֝כַ֗ף יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth;

verses.he: קוֹל נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם לְחִכָּ֥ם דָּבֵֽקָה׃
verses.en: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥יִן רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it gave witness unto me;

verses.he: כִּֽי אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝יָת֗וֹם וְֽלֹא עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried, the fatherless also, that had none to help him.

verses.he: בִּרְכַּ֣ת אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣י תָּבֹ֑א וְלֵ֖ב אַלְמָנָ֣ה אַרְנִֽן׃
verses.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me; and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

verses.he: צֶ֣דֶק לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑נִי כִּֽמְעִ֥יל וְ֝צָנִ֗יף מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
verses.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed itself with me; my justice was as a robe and a diadem.

verses.he: עֵינַ֣יִם הָ֭יִיתִי לַֽעִוֵּ֑ר וְרַגְלַ֖יִם לַפִּסֵּ֣חַ אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

verses.he: אָ֣ב אָ֭נֹכִֽי לָֽאֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים וְרִ֖ב לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: I was a father to the needy; and the cause of him that I knew not I searched out.

verses.he: וָֽ֭אֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וּ֝מִשִּׁנָּ֗יו אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף׃
verses.en: And I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

verses.he: וָ֭אֹמַר עִם קִנִּ֣י אֶגְוָ֑ע וְ֝כַח֗וֹל אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים׃
verses.en: Then I said: 'I shall die with my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the phoenix;

verses.he: שָׁרְשִׁ֣י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי מָ֑יִם וְ֝טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּקְצִירִֽי׃
verses.en: My root shall be spread out to the waters, and the dew shall lie all night upon my branch;

verses.he: כְּ֭בוֹדִי חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑י וְ֝קַשְׁתִּ֗י בְּיָדִ֥י תַחֲלִֽיף׃
verses.en: My glory shall be fresh in me, and my bow shall be renewed in my hand.'

verses.he: לִֽי שָׁמְע֥וּ וְיִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

verses.he: אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִי לֹ֣א יִשְׁנ֑וּ וְ֝עָלֵ֗ימוֹ תִּטֹּ֥ף מִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.en: After my words they spoke not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

verses.he: וְיִֽחֲל֣וּ כַמָּטָ֣ר לִ֑י וּ֝פִיהֶ֗ם פָּעֲר֥וּ לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

verses.he: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּן׃
verses.en: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

verses.he: אֶֽבֲחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּם֮ וְאֵשֵׁ֪ב רֹ֥אשׁ וְ֭אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּגְּד֑וּד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבֵלִ֣ים יְנַחֵֽם׃
verses.en: I chose out their way, and sat as chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

verses.he: וְעַתָּ֤ה שָֽׂחֲק֣וּ עָלַי֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗נִּי לְיָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר מָאַ֥סְתִּי אֲבוֹתָ֑ם לָ֝שִׁ֗ית עִם כַּלְבֵ֥י צֹאנִֽי׃
verses.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.

verses.he: גַּם כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵיהֶם לָ֣מָּה לִּ֑י עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ אָ֣בַד כָּֽלַח׃
verses.en: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? men in whom ripe age is perished.

verses.he: בְּחֶ֥סֶר וּבְכָפָ֗ן גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד הַֽעֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה׃
verses.en: They are gaunt with want and famine; they gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.

verses.he: הַקֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי שִׂ֑יחַ וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַחְמָֽם׃
verses.en: They pluck salt-wort with wormwood; and the roots of the broom are their food.

verses.he: מִן גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.en: They are driven forth from the midst of men; they cry after them as after a thief.

verses.he: בַּעֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים לִשְׁכֹּ֑ן חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר וְכֵפִֽים׃
verses.en: In the clefts of the valleys must they dwell, in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

verses.he: בֵּין שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: Among the bushes they bray; under the nettles they are gathered together.

verses.he: בְּֽנֵי נָ֭בָל גַּם בְּנֵ֣י בְלִי שֵׁ֑ם נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: They are children of churls, yea, children of ignoble men; they were scourged out of the land.

verses.he: וְ֭עַתָּה נְגִינָתָ֣ם הָיִ֑יתִי וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמִלָּֽה׃
verses.en: And now I am become their song, yea, I am a byword unto them.

verses.he: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑נִּי וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י לֹא חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק׃
verses.en: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

verses.he: כִּֽי יתרויתרויִתְרִ֣יפִ֭תַּח וַיְעַנֵּ֑נִי וְ֝רֶ֗סֶן מִפָּנַ֥י שִׁלֵּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: For He hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, and they have cast off the bridle before me.

verses.he: עַל יָמִין֮ פִּרְחַ֪ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ רַגְלַ֥י שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ וַיָּסֹ֥לּוּ עָ֝לַ֗י אָרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽם׃
verses.en: Upon my right hand rise the brood; they entangle my feet, and they cast up against me their ways of destruction.

verses.he: נָתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י לְהַוָּתִ֥י יֹעִ֑ילוּ לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: They break up my path, they further my calamity, even men that have no helper.

verses.he: כְּפֶ֣רֶץ רָחָ֣ב יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: As through a wide breach they come; in the midst of the ruin they roll themselves upon me.

verses.he: הָהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗י בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת תִּרְדֹּ֣ף כָּ֭רוּחַ נְדִבָתִ֑י וּ֝כְעָ֗ב עָבְרָ֥ה יְשֻׁעָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Terrors are turned upon me, they chase mine honour as the wind; and my welfare is passed away as a cloud.

verses.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה עָ֭לַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י יֹ֭אחֲז֣וּנִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

verses.he: לַ֗יְלָה עֲ֭צָמַי נִקַּ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְ֝עֹרְקַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃
verses.en: In the night my bones are pierced, and fall from me, and my sinews take no rest.

verses.he: בְּרָב כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י כְּפִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣י יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: By the great force of my disease is my garment disfigured; it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

verses.he: הֹרָ֥נִי לַחֹ֑מֶר וָ֝אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּעָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.en: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

verses.he: אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶיךָ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽי׃
verses.en: I cry unto Thee, and Thou dost not answer me; I stand up, and Thou lookest at me.

verses.he: תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְאַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑י בְּעֹ֖צֶם יָדְךָ֣ תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thou art turned to be cruel to me; with the might of Thy hand Thou hatest me.

verses.he: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי וּ֝תְמֹגְגֵ֗נִי תשוהתשוהתּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind, Thou causest me to ride upon it; and Thou dissolvest my substance.

verses.he: כִּֽי יָ֭דַעְתִּי מָ֣וֶת תְּשִׁיבֵ֑נִי וּבֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְכָל חָֽי׃
verses.en: For I know that Thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ לֹא בְ֭עִי יִשְׁלַח יָ֑ד אִם בְּ֝פִיד֗וֹ לָהֶ֥ן שֽׁוּעַ׃
verses.en: Surely none shall put forth his hand to a ruinous heap, neither because of these things shall help come in one's calamity,

verses.he: אִם לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה י֑וֹם עָֽגְמָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: If I have not wept for him that was in trouble, and if my soul grieved not for the needy.

verses.he: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב קִ֭וִּיתִי וַיָּ֣בֹא רָ֑ע וַֽאֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝א֗וֹר וַיָּ֥בֹא אֹֽפֶל׃
verses.en: Yet, when I looked for good, there came evil; and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

verses.he: מֵעַ֖י רֻתְּח֥וּ וְלֹא דָ֗מּוּ קִדְּמֻ֥נִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: Mine inwards boil, and rest not; days of affliction are come upon me.

verses.he: קֹדֵ֣ר הִ֭לַּכְתִּי בְּלֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַקָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ׃
verses.en: I go mourning without the sun; I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

verses.he: אָ֭ח הָיִ֣יתִי לְתַנִּ֑ים וְ֝רֵ֗עַ לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.en: I am become a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

verses.he: ע֭וֹרִי שָׁחַ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְעַצְמִי חָ֝֗רָה מִנִּי חֹֽרֶב׃
verses.en: My skin is black, and falleth from me, and my bones are burned with heat.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֣י לְ֭אֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִ֑י וְ֝עֻגָבִ֗י לְק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים׃
verses.en: Therefore is my harp turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of them that weep.

verses.he: בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל בְּתוּלָֽה׃
verses.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; how then should I look upon a maid?

verses.he: וּמֶ֤ה חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים׃
verses.en: For what would be the portion of G-d from above, and the heritage of the Almighty from on high?

verses.he: הֲלֹא אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

verses.he: הֲלֹא ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכָל צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Doth not He see my ways, and count all my steps?

verses.he: אִם הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם שָׁ֑וְא וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽי׃
verses.en: If I have walked with vanity, and my foot hath hasted to deceit--

verses.he: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹאזְנֵי צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי׃
verses.en: Let me be weighed in a just balance, that G-d may know mine integrity--

verses.he: אִ֥ם תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִי֮ מִנִּ֪י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ וְאַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י דָּ֣בַק מֻאֽוּם׃ פ
verses.en: If my step hath turned out of the way, and my heart walked after mine eyes, and if any spot hath cleaved to my hands;

verses.he: אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

verses.he: אִם נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּי עַל אִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַל פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣י אָרָֽבְתִּי׃
verses.en: If my heart have been enticed unto a woman, and I have lain in wait at my neighbour's door;

verses.he: תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ יִכְרְע֥וּן אֲחֵרִֽין׃
verses.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

verses.he: כִּי הואהואהִ֥יאזִמָּ֑ה והיאוהיאוְ֝ה֗וּאעָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים׃
verses.en: For that were a heinous crime; yea, it were an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽבְכָל תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: For it is a fire that consumeth unto destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

verses.he: אִם אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.en: If I did despise the cause of my man-servant, or of my maid-servant, when they contended with me--

verses.he: וּמָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְכִֽי יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: What then shall I do when G-d riseth up? And when He remembereth, what shall I answer Him?

verses.he: הֲֽ֝לֹא בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.en: Did not He that made me in the womb make him? And did not One fashion us in the womb?

verses.he: אִם אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה׃
verses.en: If I have withheld aught that the poor desired, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

verses.he: וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹא אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof--

verses.he: כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣י אַנְחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Nay, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, and I have been her guide from my mother's womb.

verses.he: אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: If I have seen any wanderer in want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

verses.he: אִם לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּנִי חלצוחלצוחֲלָצָ֑יווּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּֽם׃
verses.en: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

verses.he: אִם הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑י כִּֽי אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽי׃
verses.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

verses.he: כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.en: Then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder-blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.

verses.he: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.en: For calamity from G-d was a terror to me, and by reason of His majesty I could do nothing.

verses.he: אִם שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי׃
verses.en: If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold: 'Thou art my confidence';

verses.he: אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽי׃
verses.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

verses.he: אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

verses.he: וַיִּ֣פְתְּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לִבִּ֑י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק יָדִ֣י לְפִֽי׃
verses.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, and my mouth hath kissed my hand;

verses.he: גַּם ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל׃
verses.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judges; for I should have lied to G-d that is above.

verses.he: אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּפִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑י וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי מְצָ֥אוֹ רָֽע׃
verses.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or exulted when evil found him--

verses.he: וְלֹא נָתַ֣תִּי לַחֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑י לִשְׁאֹ֖ל בְּאָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Yea, I suffered not my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse.

verses.he: אִם לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑י מִֽי יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.en: If the men of my tent said not: 'Who can find one that hath not been satisfied with his meat?'

verses.he: בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח׃
verses.en: The stranger did not lodge in the street; my doors I opened to the roadside.

verses.he: אִם כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְאָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑י לִטְמ֖וֹן בְּחֻבִּ֣י עֲוֺֽנִי׃
verses.en: If after the manner of men I covered my transgressions, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom--

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּבוּז מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח׃
verses.en: Because I feared the great multitude, and the most contemptible among families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and went not out of the door.

verses.he: מִ֤י יִתֶּן לִ֨י שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְסֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי׃
verses.en: Oh that I had one to hear me! --Lo, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me--and that I had the indictment which mine adversary hath written!

verses.he: אִם לֹ֣א עַל שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי׃
verses.en: Surely I would carry it upon my shoulder; I would bind it unto me as a crown.

verses.he: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

verses.he: אִם עָ֭לַי אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃
verses.en: If my land cry out against me, and the furrows thereof weep together;

verses.he: אִם כֹּ֭חָהּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי׃
verses.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the tillers thereof to be disappointed--

verses.he: תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְתַֽחַת שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בָאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃ פ
verses.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and noisome weeds instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

verses.he: וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭אֵלֶּה מֵעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו׃ פ
verses.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

verses.he: וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֪חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭אִיּוֹב חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑וֹ עַֽל צַדְּק֥וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ מֵאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram; against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than G-d.

verses.he: וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ חָרָ֪ה אַ֫פּ֥וֹ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

verses.he: וֶֽאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב בִּדְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים׃
verses.en: Now Elihu had waited to speak unto Job, because they were older than he.

verses.he: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיִּ֥חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃ פ
verses.en: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

verses.he: וַיַּ֤עַן אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽאִירָ֓א מֵחַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said: I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I held back, and durst not declare you mine opinion.

verses.he: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: I said: 'Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.'

verses.he: אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ הִ֣יא בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם׃
verses.en: But it is a spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty, that giveth them understanding.

verses.he: לֹֽא רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: It is not the great that are wise, nor the aged that discern judgment.

verses.he: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣י אַף אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: Therefore I say: 'Hearken to me; I also will declare mine opinion.'

verses.he: הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין׃
verses.en: Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

verses.he: וְעָֽדֵיכֶ֗ם אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְאִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.en: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none that convinced Job, or that answered his words, among you.

verses.he: פֶּן תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ לֹא אִֽישׁ׃
verses.en: Beware lest ye say: 'We have found wisdom; G-d may vanquish him, not man!'

verses.he: וְלֹא עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: For he hath not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

verses.he: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא עָ֣נוּ ע֑וֹד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים׃
verses.en: They are amazed, they answer no more; words are departed from them.

verses.he: וְ֭הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא עָ֥נוּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.en: And shall I wait, because they speak not, because they stand still, and answer no more?

verses.he: אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: I also will answer my part, I also will declare mine opinion.

verses.he: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי׃
verses.en: For I am full of words; the spirit within me constraineth me.

verses.he: הִנֵּֽה בִטְנִ֗י כְּיַ֥יִן לֹא יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּאֹב֥וֹת חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ׃
verses.en: Behold, mine inwards are as wine which hath no vent; like new wine-skins which are ready to burst.

verses.he: אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְיִֽרְוַֽח לִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וְאֶֽעֱנֶֽה׃
verses.en: I will speak, that I may find relief; I will open my lips and answer.

verses.he: אַל נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה׃
verses.en: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man's person; neither will I give flattering titles unto any man.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי׃
verses.en: For I know not to give flattering titles; else would my Maker soon take me away.

verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃
verses.en: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, and hearken to all my words.

verses.he: הִנֵּה נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי׃
verses.en: Behold now, I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

verses.he: יֹֽשֶׁר לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃
verses.en: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart; and that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.

verses.he: רֽוּחַ אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃
verses.en: The spirit of G-d hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty given me life.

verses.he: אִם תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃
verses.en: If thou canst, answer thou me, set thy words in order before me, stand forth.

verses.he: הֵן אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: Behold, I am toward G-d even as thou art; I also am formed out of the clay.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא יִכְבָּֽד׃
verses.en: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.

verses.he: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.en: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words;

verses.he: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי׃
verses.en: 'I am clean, without transgression, I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me;

verses.he: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Behold, He findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for His enemy;

verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל אָרְחֹתָֽי׃
verses.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.'

verses.he: הֶן זֹ֣את לֹא צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: Behold, I answer thee: In this thou art not right, that G-d is too great for man;

verses.he: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.en: Why hast thou striven against Him? seeing that He will not answer any of his words.

verses.he: כִּֽי בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: For G-d speaketh in one way, yea in two, though man perceiveth it not.

verses.he: בַּחֲל֤וֹם חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

verses.he: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃
verses.en: Then He openeth the ears of men, and by their chastisement sealeth the decree,

verses.he: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃
verses.en: That men may put away their purpose, and that He may hide pride from man;

verses.he: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃
verses.en: That He may keep back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

verses.he: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וריבוריבוְר֖וֹבעֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן׃
verses.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and all his bones grow stiff;

verses.he: וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה׃
verses.en: So that his life maketh him to abhor bread, and his soul dainty food.

verses.he: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי ושפיושפיוְשֻׁפּ֥וּעַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃
verses.en: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones corrode to unsightliness.

verses.he: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃
verses.en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

verses.he: אִם יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: If there be for him an angel, an intercessor, one among a thousand, to vouch for a man's uprightness;

verses.he: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃
verses.en: Then He is gracious unto him, and saith: 'Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.'

verses.he: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃
verses.en: His flesh is tenderer than a child's; he returneth to the days of his youth;

verses.he: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל אֱל֨וֹהַּ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He prayeth unto G-d, and He is favourable unto him; so that he seeth His face with joy; and He restoreth unto man his righteousness.

verses.he: יָשֹׁ֤ר עַל אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃
verses.en: He cometh before men, and saith: 'I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not.'

verses.he: פָּדָ֣ה נפשינפשינַ֭פְשׁוֹמֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וחיתיוחיתיוְ֝חַיָּתוֹבָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: So He redeemeth his soul from going into the pit, and his life beholdeth the light.

verses.he: הֶן כָּל אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.en: Lo, all these things doth G-d work, twice, yea thrice, with a man,

verses.he: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַיִּים׃
verses.en: To bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

verses.he: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.en: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me; hold thy peace, and I will speak.

verses.he: אִם יֵשׁ מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me; speak, for I desire to justify thee.

verses.he: אִם אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה׃ ס
verses.en: If not, hearken thou unto me; hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Moreover Elihu answered and said:

verses.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ חֲכָמִ֣ים מִלָּ֑י וְ֝יֹדְעִ֗ים הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ לִֽי׃
verses.en: Hear my words, ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

verses.he: כִּי אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַ֥ם לֶאֱכֹֽל׃
verses.en: For the ear trieth words, as the palate tasteth food.

verses.he: מִשְׁפָּ֥ט נִבְחֲרָה לָּ֑נוּ נֵדְעָ֖ה בֵינֵ֣ינוּ מַה טּֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Let us choose for us that which is right; let us know among ourselves what is good.

verses.he: כִּֽי אָ֭מַר אִיּ֣וֹב צָדַ֑קְתִּי וְ֝אֵ֗ל הֵסִ֥יר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
verses.en: For Job hath said: 'I am righteous, and G-d hath taken away my right;

verses.he: עַל מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י אֲכַזֵּ֑ב אָנ֖וּשׁ חִצִּ֣י בְלִי פָֽשַׁע׃
verses.en: Notwithstanding my right I am accounted a liar; my wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.'

verses.he: מִי גֶ֥בֶר כְּאִיּ֑וֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה לַּ֥עַג כַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.en: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

verses.he: וְאָרַ֣ח לְ֭חֶבְרָה עִם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וְ֝לָלֶ֗כֶת עִם אַנְשֵׁי רֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.en: Who goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

verses.he: כִּֽי אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א יִסְכָּן גָּ֑בֶר בִּ֝רְצֹת֗וֹ עִם אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: For he hath said: 'It profiteth a man nothing that he should be in accord with G-d.'

verses.he: לָכֵ֤ן אַ֥נֲשֵׁ֥י לֵבָ֗ב שִׁמְע֫וּ לִ֥י חָלִ֖לָה לָאֵ֥ל מֵרֶ֗שַׁע וְשַׁדַּ֥י מֵעָֽוֶל׃
verses.en: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from G-d, that He should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that He should commit iniquity.

verses.he: כִּ֤י פֹ֣עַל אָ֭דָם יְשַׁלֶּם ל֑וֹ וּֽכְאֹ֥רַח אִ֝֗ישׁ יַמְצִאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: For the work of a man will He requite unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

verses.he: אַף אָמְנָ֗ם אֵ֥ל לֹֽא יַרְשִׁ֑יעַ וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹֽא יְעַוֵּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: Yea, of a surety, G-d will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

verses.he: מִֽי פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו אָ֑רְצָה וּמִ֥י שָׂ֝֗ם תֵּבֵ֥ל כֻּלָּֽהּ׃
verses.en: Who gave Him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?

verses.he: אִם יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣יו לִבּ֑וֹ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו יֶאֱסֹֽף׃
verses.en: If He set His heart upon man, if He gather unto Himself his spirit and his breath;

verses.he: יִגְוַ֣ע כָּל בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם עַל עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.en: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall return unto dust.

verses.he: וְאִם בִּ֥ינָה שִׁמְעָה זֹּ֑את הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְק֣וֹל מִלָּֽי׃
verses.en: If now thou hast understanding, hear this; hearken to the voice of my words.

verses.he: הַאַ֬ף שׂוֹנֵ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יַחֲב֑וֹשׁ וְאִם צַדִּ֖יק כַּבִּ֣יר תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.en: Shall even one that hateth right govern? And wilt thou condemn Him that is just and mighty--

verses.he: הַאֲמֹ֣ר לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע אֶל נְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.en: Is it fit to say to a king: 'Thou art base'? Or to nobles: 'Ye are wicked'?--

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא נָשָׂ֨א פְּנֵ֥י שָׂרִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א נִכַּר שׁ֭וֹעַ לִפְנֵי דָ֑ל כִּֽי מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדָ֣יו כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.en: That respecteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? For they all are the work of His hands.

verses.he: רֶ֤גַע יָמֻתוּ֮ וַחֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְיַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְיָסִ֥ירוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר לֹ֣א בְיָֽד׃
verses.en: In a moment they die, even at midnight; the people are shaken and pass away, and the mighty are taken away without hand.

verses.he: כִּי עֵ֭ינָיו עַל דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכָל צְעָדָ֥יו יִרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: For His eyes are upon the ways of a man, and He seeth all his goings.

verses.he: אֵֽין חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וְאֵ֣ין צַלְמָ֑וֶת לְהִסָּ֥תֶר שָׁ֝֗ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א עַל אִ֭ישׁ יָשִׂ֣ים ע֑וֹד לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֶל אֵ֝֗ל בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: For He doth not appoint a time unto any man, when he should go before G-d in judgment.

verses.he: יָרֹ֣עַ כַּבִּירִ֣ים לֹא חֵ֑קֶר וַיַּעֲמֵ֖ד אֲחֵרִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.en: He breaketh in pieces mighty men without inquisition, and setteth others in their stead.

verses.he: לָכֵ֗ן יַ֭כִּיר מַעְבָּֽדֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥פַךְ לַ֝֗יְלָה וְיִדַּכָּֽאוּ׃
verses.en: Therefore He taketh knowledge of their works; and He overturneth them in the night, so that they are crushed.

verses.he: תַּֽחַת רְשָׁעִ֥ים סְפָקָ֗ם בִּמְק֥וֹם רֹאִֽים׃
verses.en: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כֵּ֭ן סָ֣רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֑יו וְכָל דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.en: Because they turned aside from following Him, and would not have regard to any of His ways;

verses.he: לְהָבִ֣יא עָ֭לָיו צַֽעֲקַת דָּ֑ל וְצַעֲקַ֖ת עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto Him, and He heareth the cry of the afflicted.

verses.he: וְה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט וּמִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ וְיַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּמִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ וְעַל גּ֖וֹי וְעַל אָדָ֣ם יָֽחַד׃
verses.en: When He giveth quietness, who then can condemn? And when He hideth His face, who then can behold Him? whether it be done unto a nation, or unto a man, alike;

verses.he: מִ֭מְּלֹךְ אָדָ֥ם חָנֵ֗ף מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי עָֽם׃
verses.en: That the godless man reign not, that there be none to ensnare the people.

verses.he: כִּֽי אֶל אֵ֭ל הֶאָמַ֥ר נָשָׂ֗אתִי לֹ֣א אֶחְבֹּֽל׃
verses.en: For hath any said unto G-d: 'I have borne chastisement, though I offend not;

verses.he: בִּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֶ֭חֱזֶה אַתָּ֣ה הֹרֵ֑נִי אִֽם עָ֥וֶל פָּ֝עַ֗לְתִּי לֹ֣א אֹסִֽיף׃
verses.en: That which I see not teach Thou me; if I have done iniquity, I will do it no more'?

verses.he: הַֽמֵעִמְּךָ֬ יְשַׁלְמֶ֨נָּה כִּֽי מָאַ֗סְתָּ כִּי אַתָּ֣ה תִבְחַ֣ר וְלֹא אָ֑נִי וּֽמַה יָדַ֥עְתָּ דַבֵּֽר׃
verses.en: Shall His recompense be as thou wilt? For thou loathest it, so that thou must choose, and not I; therefore speak what thou knowest.

verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לֵ֭בָב יֹ֣אמְרוּ לִ֑י וְגֶ֥בֶר חָ֝כָ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֥עַֽ לִֽי׃
verses.en: Men of understanding will say unto me, yea, every wise man that heareth me:

verses.he: אִ֭יּוֹב לֹא בְדַ֣עַת יְדַבֵּ֑ר וּ֝דְבָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א בְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃
verses.en: 'Job speaketh without knowledge, and his words are without discernment.'

verses.he: אָבִ֗י יִבָּחֵ֣ן אִיּ֣וֹב עַד נֶ֑צַח עַל תְּ֝שֻׁבֹ֗ת בְּאַנְשֵׁי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Would that Job were tried unto the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

verses.he: כִּ֥י יֹ֘סִ֤יף עַֽל חַטָּאת֣וֹ פֶ֭שַׁע בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ יִסְפּ֑וֹק וְיֶ֖רֶב אֲמָרָ֣יו לָאֵֽל׃ ס
verses.en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against G-d.

verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּ וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Moreover Elihu answered and said:

verses.he: הֲ֭זֹאת חָשַׁ֣בְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אָ֝מַ֗רְתָּ צִדְקִ֥י מֵאֵֽל׃
verses.en: Thinkest thou this to be thy right, or sayest thou: 'I am righteousness before G-d',

verses.he: כִּֽי תֹ֭אמַר מַה יִּסְכָּן לָ֑ךְ מָֽה אֹ֝עִ֗יל מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.en: That thou inquirest: 'What advantage will it be unto Thee?' And: 'What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?'

verses.he: אֲ֭נִי אֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֣ מִלִּ֑ין וְֽאֶת רֵעֶ֥יךָ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: I will give thee answer, and thy companions with thee.

verses.he: הַבֵּ֣ט שָׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וְשׁ֥וּר שְׁ֝חָקִ֗ים גָּבְה֥וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the skies, which are higher than thou.

verses.he: אִם חָ֭טָאתָ מַה תִּפְעָל בּ֑וֹ וְרַבּ֥וּ פְ֝שָׁעֶ֗יךָ מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: If thou hast sinned, what doest thou against Him? And if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto Him?

verses.he: אִם צָ֭דַקְתָּ מַה תִּתֶּן ל֑וֹ א֥וֹ מַה מִיָּדְךָ֥ יִקָּֽח׃
verses.en: If thou be righteous, what givest thou Him? Or what receiveth He of thy hand?

verses.he: לְאִישׁ כָּמ֥וֹךָ רִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וּלְבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Thy wickedness concerneth a man as thou art; and thy righteousness a son of man.

verses.he: מֵ֭רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִזְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; they cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

verses.he: וְֽלֹא אָמַ֗ר אַ֭יֵּה אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֹשָׂ֑י נֹתֵ֖ן זְמִר֣וֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.en: But none saith: 'Where is G-d my Maker, who giveth songs in the night;

verses.he: מַ֭לְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמ֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?'

verses.he: שָׁ֣ם יִ֭צְעֲקוּ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י גְּא֣וֹן רָעִֽים׃
verses.en: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

verses.he: אַךְ שָׁ֭וְא לֹא יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵ֑ל וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Surely G-d will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

verses.he: אַ֣ף כִּֽי תֹ֭אמַר לֹ֣א תְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ דִּ֥ין לְ֝פָנָ֗יו וּתְח֥וֹלֵֽל לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Yea, when thou sayest thou canst not see Him--the cause is before Him; therefore wait thou for Him.

verses.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּי אַ֭יִן פָּקַ֣ד אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יָדַ֖ע בַּפַּ֣שׁ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: And now, is it for nought that He punished in His anger? And hath He not full knowledge of arrogance?

verses.he: וְ֭אִיּוֹב הֶ֣בֶל יִפְצֶה פִּ֑יהוּ בִּבְלִי דַ֝֗עַת מִלִּ֥ין יַכְבִּֽר׃ פ
verses.en: But Job doth open his mouth in vanity; he multiplieth words without knowledge.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Elihu also proceeded, and said:

verses.he: כַּתַּר לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים׃
verses.en: Suffer me a little, and I will tell thee; for there are yet words on G-d's behalf.
