verses.he: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.he: כִּֽי אָ֭מְנָם לֹא שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: For truly my words are not false; one that is upright in mind is with thee.

verses.he: הֶן אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃
verses.en: Behold, G-d is mighty, yet He despiseth not any; He is mighty in strength of understanding.

verses.he: לֹא יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked; but giveth to the poor their right.

verses.he: לֹֽא יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃
verses.en: He withdraweth not His eyes from the righteous; but with kings upon the throne He setteth them for ever, and they are exalted.

verses.he: וְאִם אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי עֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

verses.he: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: Then He declareth unto them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

verses.he: וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

verses.he: אִֽם יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃
verses.en: If they hearken and serve Him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

verses.he: וְאִם לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי דָֽעַת׃
verses.en: But if they hearken not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

verses.he: וְֽחַנְפֵי לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃
verses.en: But they that are godless in heart lay up anger; they cry not for help when He bindeth them.

verses.he: תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃
verses.en: Their soul perisheth in youth, and their life as that of the depraved.

verses.he: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם׃
verses.en: He delivereth the afflicted by His affliction, and openeth their ear by tribulation.

verses.he: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨ מִפִּי צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃
verses.en: Yea, He hath allured thee out of distress into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which is set on thy table is full of fatness;

verses.he: וְדִין רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃
verses.en: And thou art full of the judgment of the wicked; judgment and justice take hold on them.

verses.he: כִּֽי חֵ֭מָה פֶּן יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל יַטֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: For beware of wrath, lest thou be led away by thy sufficiency; neither let the greatness of the ransom turn thee aside.

verses.he: הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי כֹֽחַ׃
verses.en: Will thy riches avail, that are without stint, or all the forces of thy strength?

verses.he: אַל תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.en: Desire not the night, when peoples are cut off in their place.

verses.he: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי עַל זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: Take heed, regard not iniquity; for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

verses.he: הֶן אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה׃
verses.en: Behold, G-d doeth loftily in His power; who is a teacher like Him?

verses.he: מִֽי פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.en: Who hath enjoined Him His way? Or who hath said: 'Thou hast wrought unrighteousness'?

verses.he: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.en: Remember that thou magnify His work, whereof men have sung.

verses.he: כָּל אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.en: All men have looked thereon; man beholdeth it afar off.

verses.he: הֶן אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.en: Behold, G-d is great, beyond our knowledge; the number of His years is unsearchable.

verses.he: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For He draweth away the drops of water, which distil rain from His vapour;

verses.he: אֲשֶֽׁר יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י אָדָ֬ם רָֽב׃
verses.en: Which the skies pour down and drop upon the multitudes of men.

verses.he: אַ֣ף אִם יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, the crashings of His pavilion?

verses.he: הֵן פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה׃
verses.en: Behold, He spreadeth His light upon it; and He covereth the depths of the sea.

verses.he: כִּי בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃
verses.en: For by these He judgeth the peoples; He giveth food in abundance.

verses.he: עַל כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.en: He covereth His hands with the lightning, and giveth it a charge that it strike the mark.

verses.he: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל עוֹלֶֽה׃
verses.en: The noise thereof telleth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the storm that cometh up.

verses.he: אַף לְ֭זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑י וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of its place.

verses.he: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.en: Hear attentively the noise of His voice, and the sound that goeth out of His mouth.

verses.he: תַּֽחַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ עַל כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, and His lightning unto the ends of the earth.

verses.he: אַחֲרָ֤יו יִשְׁאַג ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: After it a voice roareth; He thundereth with the voice of His majesty; and He stayeth them not when His voice is heard.

verses.he: יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע׃
verses.en: G-d thundereth marvellously with His voice; great things doeth He, which we cannot comprehend.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לַשֶּׁ֨לַג יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For He saith to the snow: 'Fall thou on the earth'; likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of His mighty rain.

verses.he: בְּיַד כָּל אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝דַ֗עַת כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.en: He sealeth up the hand of every man, that all men whom He hath made may know it.

verses.he: וַתָּבֹ֣א חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ אָ֑רֶב וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן׃
verses.en: Then the beasts go into coverts, and remain in their dens.

verses.he: מִן הַ֭חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה׃
verses.en: Out of the Chamber cometh the storm; and cold out of the north.

verses.he: מִנִּשְׁמַת אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן קָ֑רַח וְרֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּמוּצָֽק׃
verses.en: By the breath of G-d ice is given, and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

verses.he: אַף בְּ֭רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Yea, He ladeth the thick cloud with moister, He spreadeth abroad the cloud of His lightning;

verses.he: וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בתחבולתובתחבולתובְּתַחְבּוּלֹתָ֣יולְפָעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם עַל פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.en: And they are turned round about by His guidance, that they may do whatsoever He commandeth them upon the face of the habitable world:

verses.he: אִם לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Whether it be for correction, or for His earth, or for mercy, that He cause it to come.

verses.he: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל׃
verses.en: Hearken unto this, O Job; Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of G-d.

verses.he: הֲ֭תֵדַע בְּשׂוּם אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝הוֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Dost thou know how G-d enjoineth them, and causeth the lightning of His cloud to shine?

verses.he: הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל מִפְלְשֵׂי עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים׃
verses.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of Him who is perfect in knowledge?

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Thou whose garments are warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind;

verses.he: תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק׃
verses.en: Canst thou with Him spread out the sky, which is strong as a molten mirror?

verses.he: ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: Teach us what we shall say unto Him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

verses.he: הַֽיְסֻפַּר ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע׃
verses.en: Shall it be told Him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

verses.he: וְעַתָּ֤ה לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם׃
verses.en: And now men see not the light which is bright in the skies; but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

verses.he: מִ֭צָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה עַל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד׃
verses.en: Out of the north cometh golden splendour, about G-d is terrible majesty.

verses.he: שַׁדַּ֣י לֹֽא מְ֭צָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא כֹ֑חַ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְרֹב צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה׃
verses.en: The Almighty, whom we cannot find out, is excellent in power, yet to judgment and plenteous justice He doeth no violence.

verses.he: לָ֭כֵן יְרֵא֣וּהוּ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לֹֽא יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כָּל חַכְמֵי לֵֽב׃ פ
verses.en: Men do therefore fear Him; He regardeth not any that are wise of heart.

verses.he: וַיַּֽעַן יְהוָ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב מנ הסערהמנ הסערהמִ֥ן הַסְּעָרָ֗הוַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then HaShem answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:

verses.he: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה מַחְשִׁ֖יךְ עֵצָ֥ה בְמִלִּ֗ין בְּֽלִי דָֽעַת׃
verses.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

verses.he: אֱזָר נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ וְ֝אֶשְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto Me.

verses.he: אֵיפֹ֣ה הָ֭יִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ בִינָֽה׃
verses.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast the understanding.

verses.he: מִי שָׂ֣ם מְ֭מַדֶּיהָ כִּ֣י תֵדָ֑ע א֤וֹ מִֽי נָטָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יהָ קָּֽו׃
verses.en: Who determined the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who stretched the line upon it?

verses.he: עַל מָ֭ה אֲדָנֶ֣יהָ הָטְבָּ֑עוּ א֥וֹ מִֽי יָ֝רָ֗ה אֶ֣בֶן פִּנָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Whereupon were the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner-stone thereof,

verses.he: בְּרָן יַ֭חַד כּ֣וֹכְבֵי בֹ֑קֶר וַ֝יָּרִ֗יעוּ כָּל בְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.en: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of G-d shouted for joy?

verses.he: וַיָּ֣סֶךְ בִּדְלָתַ֣יִם יָ֑ם בְּ֝גִיח֗וֹ מֵרֶ֥חֶם יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke forth, and issued out of the womb;

verses.he: בְּשׂוּמִ֣י עָנָ֣ן לְבֻשׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל חֲתֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

verses.he: וָאֶשְׁבֹּ֣ר עָלָ֣יו חֻקִּ֑י וָֽ֝אָשִׂ֗ים בְּרִ֣יחַ וּדְלָתָֽיִם׃
verses.en: And prescribed for it My decree, and set bars and doors,

verses.he: וָאֹמַ֗ר עַד פֹּ֣ה תָ֭בוֹא וְלֹ֣א תֹסִ֑יף וּפֹ֥א יָ֝שִׁ֗ית בִּגְא֥וֹן גַּלֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: And said: 'Thus far shalt thou come, but no further; and here shall thy proud waves be stayed'?

verses.he: הְֽ֭מִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּ֣יתָ בֹּ֑קֶר ידעתה שחרידעתה שחריִדַּ֖עְתָּה הַשַּׁ֣חַרמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days began, and caused the dayspring to know its place;

verses.he: לֶ֭אֱחֹז בְּכַנְפ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִנָּעֲר֖וּ רְשָׁ עִ֣יםמִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and the wicked be shaken out of it?

verses.he: תִּ֭תְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹ֣מֶר חוֹתָ֑ם וְ֝יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ׃
verses.en: It is changed as clay under the seal; and they stand as a garment.

verses.he: וְיִמָּנַ֣ע מֵרְשָׁ עִ֣יםאוֹרָ֑ם וּזְר֥וֹעַ רָ֝מָ֗ה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.en: But from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm is broken.

verses.he: הֲ֭בָאתָ עַד נִבְכֵי יָ֑ם וּבְחֵ֥קֶר תְּ֝ה֗וֹם הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃
verses.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep?

verses.he: הֲנִגְל֣וּ לְ֭ךָ שַׁעֲרֵי מָ֑וֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵ֖י צַלְמָ֣וֶת תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? Or hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?

verses.he: הִ֭תְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד רַחֲבֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃
verses.en: Hast thou surveyed unto the breadths of the earth? Declare, if thou knowest it all.

verses.he: אֵי זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן א֑וֹר וְ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ אֵי זֶ֥ה מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Where is the way to the dwelling of light, and as for darkness, where is the place thereof;

verses.he: כִּ֣י תִ֭קָּחֶנּוּ אֶל גְּבוּל֑וֹ וְכִֽי תָ֝בִ֗ין נְתִיב֥וֹת בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

verses.he: יָ֭דַעְתָּ כִּי אָ֣ז תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וּמִסְפַּ֖ר יָמֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.en: Thou knowest it, for thou wast then born, and the number of thy days is great!

verses.he: הֲ֭בָאתָ אֶל אֹצְר֣וֹת שָׁ֑לֶג וְאֹצְר֖וֹת בָּרָ֣ד תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.en: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow, or hast thou seen the treasuries of the hail,

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר חָשַׂ֥כְתִּי לְעֶת צָ֑ר לְי֥וֹם קְ֝רָ֗ב וּמִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

verses.he: אֵי זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יֵחָ֣לֶק א֑וֹר יָפֵ֖ץ קָדִ֣ים עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: By what way is the light parted, or the east wind scattered upon the earth?

verses.he: מִֽי פִלַּ֣ג לַשֶּׁ֣טֶף תְּעָלָ֑ה וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Who hath cleft a channel for the waterflood, or a way for the lightning of the thunder;

verses.he: לְ֭הַמְטִיר עַל אֶ֣רֶץ לֹא אִ֑ישׁ מִ֝דְבָּ֗ר לֹא אָדָ֥ם בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is, on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

verses.he: לְהַשְׂבִּ֣יעַ שֹׁ֭אָה וּמְשֹׁאָ֑ה וּ֝לְהַצְמִ֗יחַ מֹ֣צָא דֶֽשֶׁא׃
verses.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground, and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

verses.he: הֲיֵשׁ לַמָּטָ֥ר אָ֑ב א֥וֹ מִי ה֝וֹלִ֗יד אֶגְלֵי טָֽל׃
verses.en: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

verses.he: מִבֶּ֣טֶן מִ֭י יָצָ֣א הַקָּ֑רַח וּכְפֹ֥ר שָׁ֝מַיִם מִ֣י יְלָדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoar-frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

verses.he: כָּ֭אֶבֶן מַ֣יִם יִתְחַבָּ֑אוּ וּפְנֵ֥י תְ֝ה֗וֹם יִתְלַכָּֽדוּ׃
verses.en: The waters are congealed like stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

verses.he: הַֽ֭תְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּ֣וֹת כִּימָ֑ה אֽוֹ מֹשְׁכ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל תְּפַתֵּֽחַ׃
verses.en: Canst thou bind the chains of the Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

verses.he: הֲתֹצִ֣יא מַזָּר֣וֹת בְּעִתּ֑וֹ וְ֝עַ֗יִשׁ עַל בָּנֶ֥יהָ תַנְחֵֽם׃
verses.en: Canst thou lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season? Or canst thou guide the Bear with her sons?

verses.he: הֲ֭יָדַעְתָּ חֻקּ֣וֹת שָׁמָ֑יִם אִם תָּשִׂ֖ים מִשְׁטָר֣וֹ בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? Canst thou establish the dominion thereof in the earth?

verses.he: הֲתָרִ֣ים לָעָ֣ב קוֹלֶ֑ךָ וְֽשִׁפְעַת מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

verses.he: הַֽתְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְיֵלֵ֑כוּ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ לְךָ֣ הִנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Canst thou send forth lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee: 'Here we are'?

verses.he: מִי שָׁ֭ת בַּטֻּח֣וֹת חָכְמָ֑ה א֤וֹ מִֽי נָתַ֖ן לַשֶּׂ֣כְוִי בִינָֽה׃
verses.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the mind?

verses.he: מִֽי יְסַפֵּ֣ר שְׁחָקִ֣ים בְּחָכְמָ֑ה וְנִבְלֵ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם מִ֣י יַשְׁכִּֽיב׃
verses.en: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,

verses.he: בְּצֶ֣קֶת עָ֭פָר לַמּוּצָ֑ק וּרְגָבִ֥ים יְדֻבָּֽקוּ׃
verses.en: When the dust runneth into a mass, and the clods cleave fast together?

verses.he: הֲתָצ֣וּד לְלָבִ֣יא טָ֑רֶף וְחַיַּ֖ת כְּפִירִ֣ים תְּמַלֵּֽא׃
verses.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lioness? Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

verses.he: כִּי יָשֹׁ֥חוּ בַמְּעוֹנ֑וֹת יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַסֻּכָּ֣ה לְמוֹ אָֽרֶב׃
verses.en: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

verses.he: מִ֤י יָכִ֥ין לָעֹרֵ֗ב צֵ֫יד֥וֹ כִּֽי ילדוילדויְ֭לָדָיואֶל אֵ֣ל יְשַׁוֵּ֑עוּ יִ֝תְע֗וּ לִבְלִי אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.en: Who provideth for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry unto G-d, and wander for lack of food?

verses.he: הֲיָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֭ת לֶ֣דֶת יַעֲלֵי סָ֑לַע חֹלֵ֖ל אַיָּל֣וֹת תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

verses.he: תִּסְפֹּ֣ר יְרָחִ֣ים תְּמַלֶּ֑אנָה וְ֝יָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֣ת לִדְתָּֽנָה׃
verses.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

verses.he: תִּ֭כְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶ֣ן תְּפַלַּ֑חְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶ֥ם תְּשַׁלַּֽחְנָה׃
verses.en: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young, they cast out their fruit.

verses.he: יַחְלְמ֣וּ בְ֭נֵיהֶם יִרְבּ֣וּ בַבָּ֑ר יָ֝צְא֗וּ וְלֹא שָׁ֥בוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Their young ones wax strong, they grow up in the open field; they go forth, and return not again.

verses.he: מִֽי שִׁלַּ֣ח פֶּ֣רֶא חָפְשִׁ֑י וּמֹסְר֥וֹת עָ֝ר֗וֹד מִ֣י פִתֵּֽחַ׃
verses.en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? Or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֣מְתִּי עֲרָבָ֣ה בֵית֑וֹ וּֽמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָ֥יו מְלֵֽחָה׃
verses.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling-place.

verses.he: יִ֭שְׂחַק לַהֲמ֣וֹן קִרְיָ֑ה תְּשֻׁא֥וֹת נ֝וֹגֵ֗שׂ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.en: He scorneth the tumult of the city, neither heareth he the shoutings of the driver.

verses.he: יְת֣וּר הָרִ֣ים מִרְעֵ֑הוּ וְאַחַ֖ר כָּל יָר֣וֹק יִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

verses.he: הֲיֹ֣אבֶה רֵּ֣ים עָבְדֶ֑ךָ אִם יָ֝לִ֗ין עַל אֲבוּסֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Will the wild-ox be willing to serve thee? Or will he abide by thy crib?

verses.he: הֲֽתִקְשָׁר רֵ֭ים בְּתֶ֣לֶם עֲבֹת֑וֹ אִם יְשַׂדֵּ֖ד עֲמָקִ֣ים אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Canst thou bind the wild-ox with his band in the furrow? Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

verses.he: הֲֽתִבְטַח בּ֭וֹ כִּי רַ֣ב כֹּח֑וֹ וְתַעֲזֹ֖ב אֵלָ֣יו יְגִיעֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? Or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

verses.he: הֲתַאֲמִ֣ין בּ֭וֹ כִּי ישובישוביָשִׁ֣יבזַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְֽגָרְנְךָ֥ יֶאֱסֹֽף׃
verses.en: Wilt thou rely on him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather the corn of thy threshing-floor?

verses.he: כְּנַף רְנָנִ֥ים נֶעֱלָ֑סָה אִם אֶ֝בְרָ֗ה חֲסִידָ֥ה וְנֹצָֽה׃
verses.en: The wing of the ostrich beateth joyously; but are her pinions and feathers the kindly stork's?

verses.he: כִּֽי תַעֲזֹ֣ב לָאָ֣רֶץ בֵּצֶ֑יהָ וְֽעַל עָפָ֥ר תְּחַמֵּֽם׃
verses.en: For she leaveth her eggs on the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

verses.he: וַ֭תִּשְׁכַּח כִּי רֶ֣גֶל תְּזוּרֶ֑הָ וְחַיַּ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה תְּדוּשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may trample them.

verses.he: הִקְשִׁ֣יחַ בָּנֶ֣יהָ לְּלֹא לָ֑הּ לְרִ֖יק יְגִיעָ֣הּ בְּלִי פָֽחַד׃
verses.en: She is hardened against her young ones, as if they were not hers; though her labour be in vain, she is without fear;

verses.he: כִּֽי הִשָּׁ֣הּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ חָכְמָ֑ה וְלֹא חָ֥לַק לָ֝֗הּ בַּבִּינָֽה׃
verses.en: Because G-d hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath He imparted to her understanding.

verses.he: כָּ֭עֵת בַּמָּר֣וֹם תַּמְרִ֑יא תִּֽשְׂחַ֥ק לַ֝סּ֗וּס וּלְרֹֽכְבֽוֹ׃
verses.en: When the time cometh, she raiseth her wings on high, and scorneth the horse and his rider.

verses.he: הֲתִתֵּ֣ן לַסּ֣וּס גְּבוּרָ֑ה הֲתַלְבִּ֖ישׁ צַוָּאר֣וֹ רַעְמָֽה׃
verses.en: Hast thou given the horse his strength? Hast thou clothed his neck with fierceness?

verses.he: הְֽ֭תַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּ֑ה ה֖וֹד נַחְר֣וֹ אֵימָֽה׃
verses.en: Hast thou made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is terrible.

verses.he: יַחְפְּר֣וּ בָ֭עֵמֶק וְיָשִׂ֣ישׂ בְּכֹ֑חַ יֵ֝צֵ֗א לִקְרַאת נָֽשֶׁק׃
verses.en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength; he goeth out to meet the clash of arms.

verses.he: יִשְׂחַ֣ק לְ֭פַחַד וְלֹ֣א יֵחָ֑ת וְלֹֽא יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי חָֽרֶב׃
verses.en: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.

verses.he: עָ֭לָיו תִּרְנֶ֣ה אַשְׁפָּ֑ה לַ֖הַב חֲנִ֣ית וְכִידֽוֹן׃
verses.en: The quiver rattleth upon him, the glittering spear and the javelin.

verses.he: בְּרַ֣עַשׁ וְ֭רֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹֽא יַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּי ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.en: He swalloweth the ground with storm and rage; neither believeth he that it is the voice of the horn.

verses.he: בְּדֵ֤י שֹׁפָ֨ר יֹ֘אמַ֤ר הֶאָ֗ח וּֽ֭מֵרָחוֹק יָרִ֣יחַ מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥עַם שָׂ֝רִים וּתְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: As oft as he heareth the horn he saith: 'Ha, ha!' and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

verses.he: הֲֽ֭מִבִּינָ֣תְךָ יַֽאֲבֶר נֵ֑ץ יִפְרֹ֖שׂ כנפוכנפוכְּנָפָ֣יולְתֵימָֽן׃
verses.en: Doth the hawk soar by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?

verses.he: אִם עַל פִּ֭יךָ יַגְבִּ֣יהַּ נָ֑שֶׁר וְ֝כִ֗י יָרִ֥ים קִנּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Doth the vulture mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?

verses.he: סֶ֣לַע יִ֭שְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָ֑ן עַֽל שֶׁן סֶ֝֗לַע וּמְצוּדָֽה׃
verses.en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the stronghold.

verses.he: מִשָּׁ֥ם חָֽפַר אֹ֑כֶל לְ֝מֵרָח֗וֹק עֵינָ֥יו יַבִּֽיטוּ׃
verses.en: From thence she spieth out the prey; her eyes behold it afar off.

verses.he: ואפרחוואפרחווְאֶפְרֹחָ֥יויְעַלְעוּ דָ֑ם וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חֲ֝לָלִ֗ים שָׁ֣ם הֽוּא׃ פ
verses.en: Her young ones also suck up blood; and where the slain are, there is she.

verses.he: וַיַּ֖עַן יְהוָ֥ה אֶת אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Moreover HaShem answered Job, and said:

verses.he: הֲ֭רֹב עִם שַׁדַּ֣י יִסּ֑וֹר מוֹכִ֖יחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃ פ
verses.en: Shall he that reproveth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with G-d, let him answer it.

verses.he: וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered HaShem, and said:

verses.he: הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑ךָּ יָ֝דִ֗י שַׂ֣מְתִּי לְמוֹ פִֽי׃
verses.en: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer Thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.

verses.he: אַחַ֣ת דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְלֹ֣א אוֹסִֽיף׃ פ
verses.en: Once have I spoken, but I will not answer again; yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.

verses.he: וַיַּֽעַן יְהוָ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב מנ סערהמנ סערהמִ֥ן סְעָרָ֗הוַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then HaShem answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:

verses.he: אֱזָר נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man; I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto Me.

verses.he: הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
verses.en: Wilt thou even make void My judgment? Wilt thou condemn Me, that thou mayest be justified?

verses.he: וְאִם זְר֖וֹעַ כָּאֵ֥ל לָ֑ךְ וּ֝בְק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥הוּ תַרְעֵֽם׃
verses.en: Or hast thou an arm like G-d? And canst thou thunder with a voice like Him?

verses.he: עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָֽא֣וֹן וָגֹ֑בַהּ וְה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency, and array thyself with glory and beauty.

verses.he: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כָל גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath; and look upon every one that is proud, and abase him.

verses.he: רְאֵ֣ה כָל גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.en: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

verses.he: טָמְנֵ֣ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃
verses.en: Hide them in the dust together; bind their faces in the hidden place.

verses.he: וְגַם אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.

verses.he: הִנֵּה נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.

verses.he: הִנֵּה נָ֣א כֹח֣וֹ בְמָתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אֹנ֗וֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the stays of his body.

verses.he: יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָב֣וֹ כְמוֹ אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פחדופחדופַחֲדָ֣יויְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃
verses.en: He straineth his tail like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are knit together.

verses.he: עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.en: His bones are as pipes of brass; his gristles are like bars of iron.

verses.he: ה֭וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי אֵ֑ל הָ֝עֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He is the beginning of the ways of G-d; He only that made him can make His sword to approach unto him.

verses.he: כִּֽי ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ ל֑וֹ וְֽכָל חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, and all the beasts of the field play there.

verses.he: תַּֽחַת צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה׃
verses.en: He lieth under the lotus-trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

verses.he: יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלֲל֑וֹ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ עַרְבֵי נָֽחַל׃
verses.en: The lotus-trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח כִּֽי יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.en: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; he is confident, though the Jordan rush forth to his mouth.

verses.he: בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּ֝מֽוֹקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקָב אָֽף׃
verses.en: Shall any take him by his eyes, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

verses.he: תִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ לִוְיָתָ֣ן בְּחַכָּ֑ה וּ֝בְחֶ֗בֶל תַּשְׁקִ֥יעַ לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with a fish-hook? or press down his tongue with a cord?

verses.he: הֲתָשִׂ֣ים אַגְמ֣וֹן בְּאַפּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְח֗וֹחַ תִּקּ֥וֹב לֶֽחֱיוֹ׃
verses.en: Canst thou put a ring into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a hook?

verses.he: הֲיַרְבֶּ֣ה אֵ֭לֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִ֑ים אִם יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ רַכּֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? or will he speak soft words unto thee?

verses.he: הֲיִכְרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֣ית עִמָּ֑ךְ תִּ֝קָּחֶ֗נּוּ לְעֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: Will he make a covenant with thee, that thou shouldest take him for a servant for ever?

verses.he: הַֽתְשַׂחֶק בּ֭וֹ כַּצִּפּ֑וֹר וְ֝תִקְשְׁרֶ֗נּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

verses.he: יִכְר֣וּ עָ֭לָיו חַבָּרִ֑ים יֶ֝חֱצ֗וּהוּ בֵּ֣ין כְּֽנַעֲנִֽים׃
verses.en: Will the bands of fishermen make a banquet of him? Will they part him among the merchants?

verses.he: הַֽתְמַלֵּ֣א בְשֻׂכּ֣וֹת עוֹר֑וֹ וּבְצִלְצַ֖ל דָּגִ֣ים רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish-spears?

verses.he: שִׂים עָלָ֥יו כַּפֶּ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר מִ֝לְחָמָ֗ה אַל תּוֹסַֽף׃
verses.en: Lay thy hand upon him; think upon the battle, thou wilt do so no more.

verses.he: הֵן תֹּחַלְתּ֥וֹ נִכְזָ֑בָה הֲגַ֖ם אֶל מַרְאָ֣יו יֻטָֽל׃
verses.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain; shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

verses.he: לֹֽא אַ֭כְזָר כִּ֣י יְעוּרֶ֑נּוּ וּמִ֥י ה֝֗וּא לְפָנַ֥י יִתְיַצָּֽב׃
verses.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up; who then is able to stand before Me?

verses.he: מִ֣י הִ֭קְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם לִי הֽוּא׃
verses.en: Who hath given Me anything beforehand, that I should repay him? Whatsoever is under the whole heaven is Mine.

verses.he: לאלאלֽוֹ אַחֲרִ֥ישׁ בַּדָּ֑יו וּדְבַר גְּ֝בוּר֗וֹת וְחִ֣ין עֶרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Would I keep silence concerning his boastings, or his proud talk, or his fair array of words?

verses.he: מִֽי גִ֭לָּה פְּנֵ֣י לְבוּשׁ֑וֹ בְּכֶ֥פֶל רִ֝סְנ֗וֹ מִ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.en: Who can uncover the face of his garment? Who shall come within his double bridle?

verses.he: דַּלְתֵ֣י פָ֭נָיו מִ֣י פִתֵּ֑חַ סְבִיב֖וֹת שִׁנָּ֣יו אֵימָֽה׃
verses.en: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.

verses.he: גַּ֭אֲוָה אֲפִיקֵ֣י מָֽגִנִּ֑ים סָ֝ג֗וּר חוֹתָ֥ם צָֽר׃
verses.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

verses.he: אֶחָ֣ד בְּאֶחָ֣ד יִגַּ֑שׁוּ וְ֝ר֗וּחַ לֹא יָב֥וֹא בֵֽינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

verses.he: אִישׁ בְּאָחִ֥יהוּ יְדֻבָּ֑קוּ יִ֝תְלַכְּד֗וּ וְלֹ֣א יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
verses.en: They are joined one to another; they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

verses.he: עֲֽ֭טִישֹׁתָיו תָּ֣הֶל א֑וֹר וְ֝עֵינָ֗יו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.en: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

verses.he: מִ֭פִּיו לַפִּידִ֣ים יַהֲלֹ֑כוּ כִּיד֥וֹדֵי אֵ֝֗שׁ יִתְמַלָּֽטוּ׃
verses.en: Out of his mouth go burning torches, and sparks of fire leap forth.

verses.he: מִ֭נְּחִירָיו יֵצֵ֣א עָשָׁ֑ן כְּד֖וּד נָפ֣וּחַ וְאַגְמֹֽן׃
verses.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot and burning rushes.

verses.he: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִ֣ים תְּלַהֵ֑ט וְ֝לַ֗הַב מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.en: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

verses.he: בְּֽ֭צַוָּארוֹ יָלִ֣ין עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו תָּד֥וּץ דְּאָבָֽה׃
verses.en: In his neck abideth strength, and dismay danceth before him.

verses.he: מַפְּלֵ֣י בְשָׂר֣וֹ דָבֵ֑קוּ יָצ֥וּק עָ֝לָ֗יו בַּל יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together; they are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.

verses.he: לִ֭בּוֹ יָצ֣וּק כְּמוֹ אָ֑בֶן וְ֝יָצ֗וּק כְּפֶ֣לַח תַּחְתִּֽית׃
verses.en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, firm as the nether millstone.

verses.he: מִ֭שֵּׂתוֹ יָג֣וּרוּ אֵלִ֑ים מִ֝שְּׁבָרִ֗ים יִתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃
verses.en: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid; by reason of despair they are beside themselves.

verses.he: מַשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ חֶ֭רֶב בְּלִ֣י תָק֑וּם חֲנִ֖ית מַסָּ֣ע וְשִׁרְיָֽה׃
verses.en: If one lay at him with the sword, it will not hold; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

verses.he: יַחְשֹׁ֣ב לְתֶ֣בֶן בַּרְזֶ֑ל לְעֵ֖ץ רִקָּב֣וֹן נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

verses.he: לֹֽא יַבְרִיחֶ֥נּוּ בֶן קָ֑שֶׁת לְ֝קַ֗שׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ ל֥וֹ אַבְנֵי קָֽלַע׃
verses.en: The arrow cannot make him flee; slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

verses.he: כְּ֭קַשׁ נֶחְשְׁב֣וּ תוֹתָ֑ח וְ֝יִשְׂחַ֗ק לְרַ֣עַשׁ כִּידֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Clubs are accounted as stubble; he laugheth at the rattling of the javelin.

verses.he: תַּ֭חְתָּיו חַדּ֣וּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׂ יִרְפַּ֖ד חָר֣וּץ עֲלֵי טִֽיט׃
verses.en: Sharpest potsherds are under him; he spreadeth a threshing-sledge upon the mire.

verses.he: יַרְתִּ֣יחַ כַּסִּ֣יר מְצוּלָ֑ה יָ֝֗ם יָשִׂ֥ים כַּמֶּרְקָחָֽה׃
verses.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot; he maketh the sea like a seething mixture.

verses.he: אַ֭חֲרָיו יָאִ֣יר נָתִ֑יב יַחְשֹׁ֖ב תְּה֣וֹם לְשֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.en: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.

verses.he: אֵֽין עַל עָפָ֥ר מָשְׁל֑וֹ הֶ֝עָשׂ֗וּ לִבְלִי חָֽת׃
verses.en: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made to be fearless.

verses.he: אֵֽת כָּל גָּבֹ֥הַּ יִרְאֶ֑ה ה֝֗וּא מֶ֣לֶךְ עַל כָּל בְּנֵי שָֽׁחַץ׃ ס
verses.en: He looketh at all high things; he is king over all the proud beasts.

verses.he: וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered HaShem, and said:

verses.he: ידעתידעתיָ֭דַעְתִּיכִּי כֹ֣ל תּוּכָ֑ל וְלֹא יִבָּצֵ֖ר מִמְּךָ֣ מְזִמָּֽה׃
verses.en: I know that Thou canst do every thing, and that no purpose can be withholden from Thee.

verses.he: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה מַעְלִ֥ים עֵצָ֗ה בְּֽלִ֫י דָ֥עַת לָכֵ֣ן הִ֭גַּדְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין נִפְלָא֥וֹת מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי וְלֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃
verses.en: Who is this that hideth counsel without knowledge? Therefore have I uttered that which I understood not, things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

verses.he: שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֭א וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Hear, I beseech Thee, and I will speak; I will demand of Thee, and declare Thou unto me.

verses.he: לְשֵֽׁמַע אֹ֥זֶן שְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה עֵינִ֥י רָאָֽתְךָ׃
verses.en: I had heard of Thee by the hearing of the ear; but now mine eye seeth Thee;

verses.he: עַל כֵּ֭ן אֶמְאַ֣ס וְנִחַ֑מְתִּי עַל עָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃ פ
verses.en: Wherefore I abhor my words, and repent, seeing I am dust and ashes.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל אִיּ֑וֹב וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל אֱלִיפַ֣ז הַתֵּֽימָנִ֗י חָרָ֨ה אַפִּ֤י בְךָ֙ וּבִשְׁנֵ֣י רֵעֶ֔יךָ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּעַבְדִּ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.en: And it was so, that after HaShem had spoken these words unto Job, HaShem said to Eliphaz the Temanite: 'My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends; for ye have not spoken of Me the thing that is right, as My servant Job hath.

verses.he: וְעַתָּ֡ה קְחֽוּ לָכֶ֣ם שִׁבְעָֽה פָרִים֩ וְשִׁבְעָ֨ה אֵילִ֜ים וּלְכ֣וּ אֶל עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּ֗וֹב וְהַעֲלִיתֶ֤ם עוֹלָה֙ בַּֽעַדְכֶ֔ם וְאִיּ֣וֹב עַבְדִּ֔י יִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֧י אִם פָּנָ֣יו אֶשָּׂ֗א לְבִלְתִּ֞י עֲשׂ֤וֹת עִמָּכֶם֙ נְבָלָ֔ה כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּעַבְדִּ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Now therefore, take unto you seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to My servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt-offering; and My servant Job shall pray for you; for him will I accept, that I do not unto you aught unseemly; for ye have not spoken of Me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.'

verses.he: וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ אֱלִיפַ֨ז הַתֵּֽימָנִ֜י וּבִלְדַּ֣ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י צֹפַר֙ הַנַּ֣עֲמָתִ֔י וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשָּׂ֥א יְהוָ֖ה אֶת פְּנֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as HaShem commanded them; and HaShem accepted Job.

verses.he: וַֽיהוָ֗ה שָׁ֚ב אֶת שביתשביתשְׁב֣וּתאִיּ֔וֹב בְּהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וֹ בְּעַ֣ד רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַ֧יֹּסֶף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאִיּ֖וֹב לְמִשְׁנֶֽה׃
verses.en: And HaShem changed the fortune of Job, when he prayed for his friends; and HaShem gave Job twice as much as he had before.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵ֠לָיו כָּל אֶחָ֨יו וְכָל אחיתיואחיתיואַחְיוֹתָ֜יווְכָל יֹדְעָ֣יו לְפָנִ֗ים וַיֹּאכְל֨וּ עִמּ֣וֹ לֶחֶם֮ בְּבֵיתוֹ֒ וַיָּנֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ וַיְנַחֲמ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ עַ֚ל כָּל הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֥יא יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַיִּתְּנוּ ל֗וֹ אִ֚ישׁ קְשִׂיטָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְאִ֕ישׁ נֶ֥זֶם זָהָ֖ב אֶחָֽד׃ ס
verses.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house; and they bemoaned him, and comforted him concerning all the evil that HaShem had brought upon him; every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one a ring of gold.

verses.he: וַֽיהוָ֗ה בֵּרַ֛ךְ אֶת אַחֲרִ֥ית אִיּ֖וֹב מֵרֵאשִׁת֑וֹ וַֽיְהִי ל֡וֹ אַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר אֶ֜לֶף צֹ֗אן וְשֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ גְּמַלִּ֔ים וְאֶֽלֶף צֶ֥מֶד בָּקָ֖ר וְאֶ֥לֶף אֲתוֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.en: So HaShem blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning; and he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she-asses.

verses.he: וַֽיְהִי ל֛וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥נָה בָנִ֖ים וְשָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

verses.he: וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם הָֽאַחַת֙ יְמִימָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית קְצִיעָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖ית קֶ֥רֶן הַפּֽוּךְ׃
verses.en: And he called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

verses.he: וְלֹ֨א נִמְצָ֜א נָשִׁ֥ים יָפ֛וֹת כִּבְנ֥וֹת אִיּ֖וֹב בְּכָל הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֧ם אֲבִיהֶ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ ס
verses.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job; and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

verses.he: וַיְחִ֤י אִיּוֹב֙ אַֽחֲרֵי זֹ֔את מֵאָ֥ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה ויראויראוַיִּרְאֶ֗האֶת בָּנָיו֙ וְאֶת בְּנֵ֣י בָנָ֔יו אַרְבָּעָ֖ה דֹּרֽוֹת׃
verses.en: And after this Job lived a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

verses.he: וַיָּ֣מָת אִיּ֔וֹב זָקֵ֖ן וּשְׂבַ֥ע יָמִֽים׃
verses.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
